translations.source: “Yanzu muna bera mai watanni 4 wadanda ba su da ciwon sukari ba wadanda ke da suke fama da ciwon sukari,” in ji shi.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: “Currently, we are producing four-month-old piglets that are free of diabetes,” he said.

translations.source: Dokta Ehud Ur, farfesan magani a Jami’ar Dalhousie da ke Halifax, Nova Scotia kuma shugaban sashen likitanci da bangaren kimiyya na kungiyar masu ciwon sikari ta Kanada ya yi gargadin cewa har yanzu binciken yana kan farkonsa.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, a medical researcher at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and head of the medical and chemistry department of the Canadian Association of Cancer Survivors, warned that the research is still in its early stages.

translations.source: Kamar wasu ƙwararrun, yana da shakkun cewa ko za a iya warkar da ciwon sukari, inda ya bayyana cewa sakamakon bincike ba shi da alaƙa da mutanen da tuni su ke da nau’in ciwon sukari na 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like some experts, he expressed concern that diabetes may not be curable, citing research findings that do not support the idea that people with existing type 1 diabetes can be cured.

translations.source: A ranar Litinin, Sara Danius, sakatariyar dindindin ta Kwamitin Adabi na kungiyar nagartattu a Kwalejin Nazarin Sweden, ta sanar a bainar jama'a yayin wani shirin rediyo a Sveriges Radio a Sweden kwamitin, ba zai iya kaiwa ga Bob Dylan kai tsaye ba game da lashe kyautar Nobel ta 2016 a Adabi, ta yi watsi da ita kokarinta na isa gare shi.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, chairwoman of the Swedish Academy's Nobel Committee for Literature, announced on a radio program on Sveriges Radio that the committee would not be awarding the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature to Bob Dylan. She stated that the committee had considered his work, but ultimately decided not to honor him with the prize.

translations.source: Danius ya ce, “Yanzu haka ba mwa yin komi. Na kira na kuma aika emails zuwa abokan aikinsa na kusa na kuma anshi amsoshi masu kyau. A yanzu haka, wannan bai isa ba.”
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: Daniel said, "Right now, there's not much I can do. I've contacted my colleagues and sent them emails, but they haven't responded yet. So, at this point, it's not enough."

translations.source: A baya, Shugaban kamfanin Ring, Jamie Siminoff, ya bayyana cewa kamfanin ya fara lokacin da ba a jiyo sauti kararrawar jikin ƙofar sa daga shagonsa a cikin garejinsa.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier, Ring CEO Jamie Siminoff revealed that the company began when he noticed the sound of his front door opening and closing in his hallway.

translations.source: Ya ce, ya gina ƙararrawar ƙofa ta WiFi.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He said he was setting up the Wi-Fi router.

translations.source: Siminoff yace ciniki ya karu baya futuwar sa ta 2013 a shinrin wasan kwaikwayin Shark Tank inda masu shirin suka ki biyan kudin sabuwar sana'ar.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff stated that his business venture failed in 2013 when he appeared on the reality show Shark Tank, where investors refused to invest in his new business.

translations.source: A ƙarshen 2017, Siminoff ya bayyana a tashar telebijin mai sayarwa ta QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on the home shopping channel QVC.

translations.source: Ring ta kuma sasanta takardar kotu tsakanin wata kamfanin adawa na tsaro wato ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: The ring also referred to a court document involving a security company, specifically ADT Corporation.

translations.source: Yayinda allurar gwaji rigakafi guda daya ta bayyana tana iya rage mutuwar cutar ta Ebola, har zuwa yanzu, babu wasu kwayoyi da aka nuna da suka dace da maganin cututtukan da suke kamuwa da su.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: While a single-dose vaccine has shown promise in reducing the risk of contracting Ebola, there are currently no other vaccines that have been proven to be effective against the disease.

translations.source: Wani hadaddiyar giyar, ZMapp, da farko ya nuna alƙawari a fagen, amma nazarin yau da kullun ya nuna cewa ba shi da fa'ida fiye da yadda ake neman hana mutuwa.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: A recent study, the ZMapp virus was initially believed to have the potential to treat cancer, but further research has shown that it is not as effective as previously thought.

translations.source: a nan gwajin PALM, ZMapp yayi bauta a wajen kula, hakan na nufin masana fasaha sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin kasan idan ka kimanta da hanyoyin guda uku nashi.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: The PALM test, along with the ZMapp test, is a diagnostic tool used to assess a person's ability to perform three specific tasks.

translations.source: Masu wasan tsalle tsalle na Amurka sun goyi bayan wasikar kwamitin gasar olympic tare da yarda da cikakkiyar bukatar duk masu wasan olympic da su yada maganar samar da yanayi mara hadari ga dukkan yan wasanmu.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: American athletes have voiced their support for the Olympic committee's proposal, emphasizing the urgent need for a safe and secure environment for all Olympic athletes.

translations.source: Mun yarda da bayanin USOC cewa bukatun ƴan wasanmu da kungiyar mu, da wasanninsu, na iya zama mafi alheri ta ci gaba tare da canji mai ma'ana a cikin ƙungiyarmu, maimakon ƙaddamar da doka.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: According to USOC, the needs of our athletes and our team, as well as their specific requirements, may be better met through a more comprehensive program, rather than simply implementing a new rule.

translations.source: Kungiyan daki motsa jiki na USA na goyon bayan bincike mai zaman kanta wadda take zaton zata kara haske kan cin zarafi wadda wadanda suka tsira daga Larry Nassar suka bayana wadda ba a gano ba na tsawon lokaci kuma ke rungume da duk wani canji mai muhimmanci.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: The U.S. Department of Justice has announced its support for an independent investigation into allegations of long-term abuse by Larry Nassar, which survivors have described as pervasive and deeply disturbing.

translations.source: Gidan motsa jiki na Amurka da USOC suna da manufa ɗaya - sa wasan motsa jiki, da sauransu, ya zama mai aminci yadda zai yiwu ƴan wasa su bi mafarkinsu cikin aminci, tabbatacce kuma mai ba da ƙarfi.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: The US Olympic Committee and the USADA share a common goal – to ensure that athletes can compete safely, fairly, and with integrity.

translations.source: A duk tsawon 1960, Brzezinski yayi ma John F. Kenedy aiki a matsayin mai bada shawara kuma yayi aiki da gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: From the 1960s, Brzezinski served as an advisor to John F. Kennedy and later worked for the administration of Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: A yayin zabukan 1976 ya shawarci Carter kan manufofin kasashen waje, sannan ya zama mai ba da shawara kan Tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, ya gaji Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1976 election, Carter advised on foreign policy, and later served as National Security Advisor from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: kasancewarsa dan NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter a harkokin dokokin kasashen waje wajen kula da lamuran duniya, kamar Yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaita alaƙar Amurka da China tana tunanin ƙarshen shekarun 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin garkuwar da Iran, 1979; da mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As a National Security Advisor, he assisted Carter in foreign policy matters, including the Camp David Accords of 1978; the evolving relationship between the United States and China in the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran-Iraq War in 1980; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

translations.source: Fin ɗin, da ke nuna Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya sami shiga cikin duk manyan ɓangarorin gasar.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The film, starring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, has been nominated for several major awards.

translations.source: Gosling da Stone sun sami shiga neman cikin kyautar Fitaccen Jarumi da Jaruma.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone have entered the running for the prestigious Best Actor and Actress awards.

translations.source: Sauran zaɓin sun hada da Hoto Mafi Kyau, Darakta, Majigi, Tsara Tufafi, Gyaran fina-finai, Makin Asali, Tsara Shiri, Gyara Sauti, Haɗa Sauti da kuma Asalin Labari.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: The categories include: Best Photo, Director, Actor, Costume Design, Film Editing, Original Score, Screenplay, Sound Editing, and News Reporting.

translations.source: Waƙoƙi biyu daga fim, Audition (Wawaye Waɗanda Suke Mafarki) da Birnin Taurari, sun karɓi zaɓi don mafi kyawun waƙar asali. Lionsgate studio ta sami nadin 26 - fiye da kowane sauran ɗakunan studio.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the film, "Audition (Dreams of a Girl)" and "City of Shadows," have been selected as the best original songs. The Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations – more than any other studio.

translations.source: A daren ranar Lahadi shugaban kasar Amurka Donald Trump a cikin wata sanarwa da aka fitar ta sanarwar sakataren, ya sanar da dakarun kasar Amurka zasu bar kasar Syria.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On a Sunday, U.S. President Donald Trump, in a statement released by the White House, announced that U.S. troops would be withdrawn from Syria.

translations.source: An bayar da sanarwar ce bayan Trump ya yi ganawa ta wayar salula da Shugaban Turkiyya Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement came after President Trump held a phone call with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

translations.source: Haka kuma Turkiyya za ta karbi aikin gadin mayakan ISIS da aka kama waɗanda, sanarwar ta ce, kasashen Turai suka ki mayar da su.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, European countries have refused to take back the captured ISIS fighters, according to the announcement.

translations.source: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa ba wai kawai wasu dabbobin dinasour suna da gashi ba, wata fadar ma da ta yadu, amma ta yi cikakken bayanin da rubabbun halittu ba za su iya ba, kamar su launi da kuma tsarin kashi uku.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This confirms that not only were some dinosaur species covered in scales, as previously believed, but that the type of scales varied, with different colors and patterns.

translations.source: Masana ilimin kimiya sun ce fiffiken dabbar launi kasa ne a sama mai dauke da kodaden launi da launin toka-toka ta karkashin ta.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have found that the cloud appears to be a mixture of white and gray, with a mottled pattern of colors underneath.

translations.source: Binciken ya kuma ba da haske game da juyin halittar fukafiki a tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The study also shed light on the behavior of vultures in the wild.

translations.source: Domin gashin fuka-fukin dinosaur bashi da isasshen tsari, wanda ake kira kara, amma suna da sauran sifofin gashin fuka-fukan — tsandar gashi da kananan — masu binciken sun kammala cewa wata kila karan wani cigaba ne na juyin halittan wadannan sauran sifofin.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the relatively small size of dinosaur fossils, they are often referred to as "microfossils," but they share many of the same characteristics as other dinosaur fossils — such as being composed of hard, bony material — and scientists have concluded that they represent a significant addition to our understanding of these other types of fossils.

translations.source: Tsarin gashin fuka-fukan ya nuna cewa ba ana amfani da su ba ne domin tashi sama, sai dai domin samar da tsarin daidaiton dumin jiki da kuma motsawa. Binciken ya nuna cewa duk da cewa jelar ta wani karamin kakan kadangare ce, abin na nuna cewa gashin balagagge ne ba na dan tsako ba.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The study revealed that these feathers are not used for flight, but rather for creating a stable and streamlined body shape and for movement. The research also showed that, despite being small, the feathers are not flimsy, but rather strong and resilient.

translations.source: Masu binciken sun nuna cewa, duk da cewa sun gamsu jelar ta kakannin kadangare ce, ta kuma nuna cewa ta balagagge ce ba jariri ba.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The investigators found that, while the alleged perpetrator was considered a suspect, the evidence indicated that he was not the actual culprit.

translations.source: Jiya da safe a ƙasar Turkiyya, wani bom na cikin mota da aka tayar a hedikwatar ‘yansanda da ke Gaziantep, ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar jami’an ‘yan sanda biyu tare da raunata wasu mutane sama da ashirin.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: In Turkey yesterday, a car bomb exploded at a police headquarters in Gaziantep, killing two police officers and injuring more than twenty people.

translations.source: Ofishin gwamnan ya ce jamia’an yan sanda goma sha tara ne su ka sami raunuka.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The governor's office stated that the police had apprehended a total of thirty-six suspects.

translations.source: Ƴan sanda sun ce suna zargin wani da ake zargin dan ta'addar Daesh (ISIL) ne da alhakin kai harin.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police officials stated that they suspect a man of being a member of the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) and are investigating him for possible involvement in terrorism.

translations.source: Sun gano cewa Rana na aiki akan manufa iri daya kamar sauran taurari: An gano cewa ayukkan duk taurari a cikin tsarin suna samuwa ne ta hasken su, juyin su, banda haka babu komai.
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: It was discovered that Rana operates according to a single principle, similar to other celestial bodies: all the features of the planet are determined by its light, its rotation, and nothing else.

translations.source: Ana amfani da haskawa da juyawa tare domin sanin lambar Rossby ta tauraro, wadda take da alaƙa da gudanar jini.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: The use of light and movement is employed to determine the Rossby number, which is related to blood flow.

translations.source: Rashin karfin lambar Rossby daidai yake da rashin karfin tauraron tare da magnetic reversal
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: The lack of a Rossby number corresponds to the absence of wind, along with magnetic reversal.

translations.source: A lokacin tafiyarsa, Iwasaki ya shiga cikin matsala a lokuta da yawa.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: During his travels, Iwasaki often found himself embroiled in various problems.

translations.source: Yan fashin teku sun yi masa fashi, mahaukacin kare ya kai masa farmaki a Tibet, ya guje wa aure a Nepal kuma an kama shi a India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: He was arrested for counterfeiting, spent time in prison in Tibet, was extradited to Nepal for trial, and then arrested in India.

translations.source: Kwatancin 802.11n na aiki duk akan mita 2.4Ghz da 5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4 GHz and 5.0 GHz frequency bands.

translations.source: Wannan zai ba shi damar zama mai dacewa da baya 802.11a, 802.11b da 802.11g, matukar dai tashar tushe tana da rediyo biyu.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This will allow it to be compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b, and 802.11g standards, provided that the base station has two radios.

translations.source: Gudun 802.11n na da saurin da ya zarce na wanda ya gabace shi da tsaikon saurin da ya kai 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard offers a speed that surpasses its predecessor, with a maximum data transfer rate of 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, wanda ke da mata da manyan yaya guda biyu, bai burge Miller ba, wanda ke da alaƙa da labarin.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, who had two adult children, was not involved in the case against Miller, who was also a party in the matter.

translations.source: Da aka nemi tsokacinsa, sai Miller ya ce, “Mike ya yi magana da yawa lokacin zaman jin ba’asin...ina kan shiri saboda haka ban saurari abin da yake cewa ba.”
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When asked about it, Miller said, "Mike spoke a lot during the meeting... I didn't really pay attention to what he was saying."

translations.source: “Za mu kokarin rage fitar da gurbataccen carbon dioxide a kowane bangare na GDP ta wani muhimmin mataki a 2020 daga matakin 2005,” in ji Hu.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: "Our goal is to significantly reduce the emission of carbon dioxide across all sectors of the economy, representing a major step towards achieving our targets by 2020, compared to the 2005 level," said Hu.

translations.source: Bai sanya wani adadi don ragewar ba, inda ya ce hakan zai danganta ne da abin da tattalin arzikin China ke fitarwa.
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: He stated that the increase would be based on the amount of goods China exports.

translations.source: Hu ya karfafa kasashe masu tasowa “da su guji tsohuwar hanyar gurbatar da farko da kuma tsabtace ta daga baya.”
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: He encouraged countries to "move away from the outdated and ineffective first-generation approach and adopt a more modern and effective strategy."

translations.source: Ya kara da cewa “ kada su yunkura, sai dai kuwa ana sa su daukar nauyi sama da na matakin cigaban su, da kuma daukan alhaki da iyawar su.”
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: He added, "They should not be exploited, but rather, they should be given the opportunity to develop their skills and talents to their full potential, while also being treated with respect and dignity."

translations.source: Kungiyar bincike na Iraq sun gabatar da rohotonsu da karfe 12.00 GMT a yau.
translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.hypothesis: The Iraqi research team will present their findings at 12:00 GMT today.

translations.source: An yi kashedin cewa babu tabbacin cewa duk wani mataki da za’a dauka a kasar Iraki a yanzu zai iya maganin yakin banbance banbance darika, karuwar rikici ko ma dosar rashin doka da oda.
translations.reference: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.hypothesis: It is reported that there is no guarantee that any measure taken in Iraq at this time will be effective in resolving the ongoing conflict, reducing violence, or addressing the underlying causes of instability.

translations.source: Rahoton ya buɗe ne tare da roƙo don buɗe muhawara da kuma kafa yarjejeniya a Amurka game da manufofin Gabas ta Tsakiya.
translations.reference: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.hypothesis: The report was introduced with a request to initiate a dialogue and establish an agreement in the United States regarding the goals of the Central African region.

translations.source: Rahoton ya yi matuƙar yin suka ga kusan dukkan ɓangarorin manufar Ɓangaren zartaswa na yanzu akan ƙasar Iraƙi inda ya nemi a gaggauta canja alƙibla.
translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The report thoroughly examined all aspects of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' current policy towards Iraq, with a focus on the need for immediate changes.

translations.source: Na farko daga cikin shawarwarin da ta ba su guda 78 shi ne cewa ya kamata a dauki wani sabon shiri na diflomasiyya kafin karshen wannan shekarar don kiyaye iyakokin Iraki kan tsoma bakin da ake yi da kuma sake kulla alakar diflomasiyya da makwabtanta.
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: One of the 78 recommendations was that a new diplomatic initiative should be launched before the end of the year to maintain Iraq's sovereignty and to rebuild relations with its neighbors.

translations.source: Majalisar dattijai da matar shugaban kasar Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner ta sanar da fitowar takarar shugaban kasa a yammacin jiya a La Plata, gari dake kilomita 50 (Mil 31) daga Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: The Argentine Congress and First Lady Cristina Fernández de Kirchner announced the presidential election results in the late afternoon in La Plata, a city about 50 kilometers (31 miles) from Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner ta bayyana ra’niyyarta ta tsayawa takarar shugabanci a Gidan wasannin Argentina, wurin da ta yi amfani da shi domin fara kanfen ɗinta na takarar Majalisar Dattawa a shekarar 2005 a matsayinta na wakiliyar Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: Mrs. Kirchner expressed her determination to run for president at the Allianza Popular stadium, where she used the venue to launch her campaign for a seat in the National Congress in 2005, while serving as a representative for Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa shine wanda yafi ciyowa innings kwallo, inda ya ciwo kwallo 41 a cikin 70 ta duka me hudu sau 11 da kuma me shiga sau 2.

translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa is the batsman with the most sixes, having hit 41 sixes in 70 innings, with 11 boundaries and 2 wickets.

translations.source: ‘Yan wasan kurket na tsakiya, Sachin Tendulkar da Rahul Dravid, sun yi kokari kuma sun yi haɗin gwiwa tare a Tseren-ɗari.

translations.hypothesis: The central batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, worked together effectively during the match.

translations.hypothesis: However, after India's batting collapse, they were left with only 36 runs on the board, having lost 7 wickets in their innings.

translations.source: Shugaban kasar America George W. Bush ya iso Singapore a safiya 16 ga Nuwanba, domin fara yawon bude ido na tsawon mako daya a Asiya.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore on Saturday, October 16, to begin a one-week visit to Asia.

translations.source: Mataimakin Firayi Ministan Singapore Wong Kan Sang ne ya tarbe shi, sannan su ka tattauna al’amuran kasuwanci da ta’addanci tare da Firayi Ministan Singapore Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: His father, Wong Kan Sang, was a senior minister in Singapore, and he had the opportunity to discuss business and security matters with Singapore's Prime Minister, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: Bayan mako guda da shan kaye a zabukan tsakiyar wa’adi, Bush ya fada wa wasu magoya baya fadadar kasuwanci a Asiya.
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: Following a week of intense campaigning and debates, Bush has made a plea to undecided voters in Asia, urging them to consider his business-oriented policies.

translations.source: Firayi Minista Stephen Harper, ya amince da aika kudurin ‘Dokar “Tsarkakakkiyar Iska’ zuwa ga kwamitin gamayyar jam’iyyu don sake dubawa, kafin ayi mata karatu na biyu, bayan taron mintuna 25 na ranar Talata tare da shugaban jam’iyyar NDP Jack Layton a PMO.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to put forward the "Clean Air Act" for a second reading in Parliament after a 25-minute meeting on Tuesday with NDP leader Jack Layton at the Prime Minister's Office.

translations.source: Layton ya nemi canje-canje ga dokar ra’ayin mazan jiya yanayi lokacin haduwa da Firayim Ministan, yana tambaya don “cikakken sake rubutawar” dokan Jam'iyyar ra’ayin mazan jiya.
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: Layton requested a revision of the party's policy on youth involvement during meetings with the Prime Minister, asking for a "complete rewrite" of the party's youth policy.

translations.source: Tun daga lokacin da Gwamnatin Tarayya ta shiga daukar nauyin asibitin Mersey da ke Devonport, Tasmania, gwamnatin jihar da wasu ‘yan majalisar tarayya sun soki wannan aikin a matsayin ci gaban shirin zaben tarayya da za a kira a watan Nuwamba.
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the federal government took over the management of the Mersey Hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal lawmakers have criticized this move as part of a broader plan to undermine the upcoming federal election, scheduled for November.

translations.source: Amma Firayim Minista John Howard ya ce dokar an yi ta ne domin kare ginin asibitin domin kada gwamnatin Tasmania ta rage masa kima, wajen kara kudaden da dala miliyan 45 ta Australiya.
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.

translations.hypothesis: Recent reports indicate that seismic data suggests the possibility of a tsunami. In fact, tsunami-like activity has been detected near Pago and Niue.

translations.source: Ba a sami wata mummunar barna ko jin ciwo a rahoton da ke fitowa daga Tonga ba, amma kuma wutar lantarki ta katse, abinda ya hana hukumomi samun sanarwar gargadin tsunami wanda hukumar PTWC ta bayar.
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: While there were no reports of significant damage or casualties from the Tonga eruption, the power outage prevented local authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (PTWC).

translations.source: Shugaban Amurka George W. Bush ya yi maraba da sanarwar.

translations.hypothesis: Just as the gravitational pull of a passing star can disrupt the orbits of nearby asteroids, the gravitational influence of the Milky Way galaxy can affect the orbits of stars in the Sagittarius constellation.

translations.hypothesis: Currently, the prevalence of XDR-TB (Extensively Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis) among all populations with a history of TB remains a significant concern; with approximately 6,000 out of the total 330,000 people who contract TB in Southern Africa having the drug-resistant form.

translations.source: “Tana da kyau sannan tana waka da kyau, kuma,” ya bayana bisa ga kwafi na taron masu yada labaru.

translations.source: Mintuna biyar da fara nunin wata iska ya fara shigowa ciki, kusan minti daya daga baya, iskar ta doshi 70km/h... daga baya ruwan sama yazo, amma da yawa da ƙarfinsa ya sauko yadda zai bugi fatarka kamar allura, saannan wani kankara ya fado daga sama, mutane suna firgita suna kururuwa suna tattake juna.

Shortly after, the rain started, but it quickly turned into a heavy downpour that was so intense it felt like it was trying to knock you off your feet. Then, a large tree fell from the sky, and people screamed and ran for cover.

translations.source: Na rasa yar uwata tare da kawarta, kuma a hanya na gamu da wasu nakasassu biyu a kan keke, jama’a suna ta tsallake su tare da tura su,” inji Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK ta kuma ruwaito cewa masana’antar samar da makamashin nukiliya ta Kashiwazaki Kariwa a gundumar Niigata tana aiki yadda yakamata.

translations.source: An ba da rohoto cewa gidaje 9400 a yankin ba su da ruwa sannan kusan 100 ba su da lantarki.

translations.hypothesis: Three government buildings have been set on fire in a span of two days.

translations.hypothesis: The two methods work together to produce a foam that can effectively extinguish fires, researchers at the university said.

translations.source: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kiristal sun taru a fisarin kyanwa ta hanyar karin sinadarin melanin da cyanuric.
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.

translations.source: Ban sani ba ko kun gane shi ko a'a, amma yawancin kayayyaki daga Amurka ta Tsakiya sun shigo wannan ƙasa ba tare da biyan haraji ba.

translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: I don't understand, it seems there is no fairness or justice here.

translations.source: Kawai abin da na ke ce wa mutane shine ku bi da mu yadda muke bi da ku.
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: What I always tell people is to follow my example and do things the same way I do.

translations.source: Gwamnan California Arnold Schwarzenegger ya sanya hannu a cikin wata doka da ta hana sayarwa ko hayar wasannin bidiyo mai tashin hankali ga ƙananan yara.
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed a law that prohibits the sale or distribution of violent video games to minors.

translations.source: Dokar na bukatar a sanya wa wasannin bidiyo na tashin hankali da ake sayarwa a jihar California alama da ke nuna “18” inda ya zamo sayar da su ga kananan yara laifi ne mai jawo hukuncin tarar $1000 a kowane laifi.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The law requires that video games that are deemed to be violent and are sold in the state of California must carry a warning label that says "18," indicating that they are not suitable for minors. Selling such games to minors is considered a misdemeanor and can result in a fine of $1,000 per violation.

translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: The tiger belongs to the same family as lions, leopards, and jaguars, which is the Panthera genus. These four species are the only ones in their genus.

translations.source: Rurin damisa bai yi kama da cikeke ƙarfin murya zaki ba, amma ya fi kama da gurnani na jimlar kalmomin da aka faɗa da ƙarfi.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: The area of silence was not like a sudden, sharp noise, but rather more like a quiet space where words were spoken with great emphasis.

translations.source: Ƴan wasa suna son cin kananan dabbobi. Za su kama birai, macizai, zazzage da tsuntsaye in sun iya. Kusan dukkan dabbobin da dutsen ya farauto suna ƙasa da shi.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: The players enjoy eating small animals. They would catch mice, rats, and other small creatures that they could find. Most of the animals they hunted were found near the river.

translations.source: Masana ilimin kimiyya suna tunanin cewa ocelots na bin dabbobi da kama su ta hanyar sansanar sawun inda su ka bi su ka wuce.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists believe that ocelots follow animals and capture them by tracking their movements through the forest.

translations.source: Suna iya gani sosai cikin duhu tare da ganin na dare, kuma suna tafiya cikin sanɗa. Kyanwar daji na farautar abin farautar su ta hanyar sajewa da wurin da su ke sannan su dirar wa abin farautar su.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: They can be seen very clearly in the dark, and they move silently through the grass. The blades of grass around their bodies are bent and broken, and they leave no trace of their passage.

translations.source: Yayin da wani karamin gungun dabbobi (jama’a kadan) su ka kasance sun rabu da babban gungun da su ke ciki (misali idan su ka koma kan wasu jerin tsaunuka, ko wani kogi ko kuma su ka koma wani sabon tsibirin yadda ba zasu iya komowa ba) akasari su kan sami kansu a muhalli na daban da inda su ka fito.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When a small group of animals (a few individuals) become separated from the larger group they are part of (for example, if they wander off onto a different trail, or into a new area that they cannot easily return to), they are likely to find themselves in a different environment where they can survive on their own.

translations.source: Wannan sabon muhallin yana da albarkatu daban da kuma masu gasa daban, don haka sabuwar al’umma za ta buƙaci mabambantan fasali ko karɓuwa don zama ƙaƙƙarfar mai gasafiye da abin da su ka buƙata a baya.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment has different resources and different types of competitors, so the new community will need specific strategies or approaches to become successful and meet its previous needs.

translations.source: Asalin al’umman basu canza ba ko kadan, suna bukatan karbuwa kamar da.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The original community is relatively stable, but it could benefit from some outside influence or input.

translations.source: A kan lokaci, yayin da sabbin yawan jama’a suka fara daidaita da sabon yanayin su, sai su fara dawo kadan da kadan kamar waɗancan yawan jama'a.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as new populations settle into their new environments, they gradually begin to resemble the original populations in terms of characteristics and behavior.

translations.source: A ƙarshe, bayan dubun dubbai ko ma shekaru miliyoyi, yawar jama’a biyu za su zauna da banbancin da ba za a kira su da wannan jinsin ba.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, after decades or even centuries, two individuals from different generations will find themselves sitting together, with a gap in understanding that makes it difficult to connect on a personal level.

translations.source: Samar da sabon jinsi, hanya ce mai mahimmanci wadda ba za’a iya kauce mata ba a cikin tsarin asalin halittu.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: The ability to adapt to new environments is a crucial trait that cannot be ignored in the natural world.

translations.source: Shuke-shuke suna sanya iskar oxygen wanda mutane ke shaka, kuma suna shan iskar carbon-dioxide wanda mutane ke fitarwa (ma'ana fitar da iska).
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants release oxygen, which humans breathe, and they absorb carbon dioxide, which humans exhale (meaning they take in gas).

translations.source: Tsire-tsire suna yin abincinsu daga rana ta hanyar hotuna. Suna kuma bayar da inuwa.
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Butterflies feed on nectar from flowers. They also excrete waste.

translations.source: Muna gina gidajenmu ne daga itatuwa kuma muna yin sitirunmu daga itatuwa. Mafi yawan abincin da muke ci daga tsirrai ne. Idan babu tsirrai, mutane da dabbobi ba za su rayu ba.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our houses and make our furniture from wood. Most of our food comes from trees. Without trees, people and animals would not survive.

translations.source: Mosasaurus ita ce babbar dabbar da ke farautar dabbobi a zamaninta, don haka bata fargabar komi ba, in ban da dabbobin Mosasaurs.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: Mosasaurus was a large marine reptile that lived during the Mesozoic Era, so it was not a direct ancestor of modern-day reptiles.

translations.source: Dogon haban sa sun cika da hakora masu ci kamar reza sama da 70, tare da ƙarin saiti a cikin rufin bakinsa, ma'ana babu mafaka ga wani abu wanda ya ketare hanyar sa.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: The vast expanse was covered in a dense thicket of trees, with over seventy different species, and a variety of plants growing on the ground, making it impossible to pass through without getting lost.

translations.source: Bamuda tabbaci amma watakila yana da harshe me cokali me yatsu. abincin shi ya hada dodon kodi, manyan kifaye, da wasu masosaurs kuma zai iya akwai mai cin nama.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: The dinosaur was large, perhaps even as big as a house. Its diet consisted of plants, including ferns and cycads, and it may have also eaten meat.

translations.source: Ta na kai wa duk wani abu farmaki da ya shiga ruwan, ko da kuwa gabjejen kakan kadangare mai suna T.Rex ba zai iya ja da shi ba.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: Anything that comes into contact with water, even a dinosaur-like creature called T.Rex, cannot be harmed by it.

translations.source: Duk da yake yawancin abincinsu zai zama sananne gare mu, Romawa suna da nasu yankin na baƙin bukukuwa ko abubuwan biki da ba a saba da su ba, da suka haɗa da akuyar daji, dawisu, dodon-koɗi, da kuma wani nau’in ɓera da ake kira dormousee
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: Although much of their food is familiar to us, the Romanians have a unique collection of wild plants and edible mushrooms, including wild berries, herbs, and various types of mushrooms.

translations.source: Wani banbamcin kuma shi ne talakawa da kuma mata sun cinye abincinsu yayin da suke zaune a kan kujeru, masu hannu da shuni kuma suna son cin abinci tare a inda suke zama a manya-manyan dakunan shakatawa domin cin abincin.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: One observation is that the poor and women are often seen eating their meals while sitting on the floor, while those who are wealthier and men prefer to eat at tables in large restaurants.

translations.source: Cikin abubuwan da ake ci a tsohuwar daular Rum, ba zai kasance abincin da ya zo Turai daga Amurka ba ko kuma daga Asia a karnonin da su ka zo daga baya.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: Among the ingredients used in the ancient Roman diet, there would not be any food items that originated in Europe or Asia during that time period.

translations.source: Alal misali, ba su da masara, babu tumatur, babu dankali. babu koko, kuma babu mutumin tsohuwar Rum da ya taɓa ɗanɗana talotalo.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, there were no tables, chairs, or beds. There was no porridge, and no elderly woman from Romania who used to enjoy watching television.

translations.source: Yan Babylon sun gina wa kowanne allansu haikali da ya zama matsayin gidan allan.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The people of Babylon built a separate dwelling for each family, which served as their home.

translations.source: Mutane za su kawo hadaya ga abubuwan bauta yayin da malaman bautar za su yi ƙoƙarin biyan buƙatun abubuwan bautar ta hanyar bukukuwa da shagulgula.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People will be able to see the results of the elections when the election officials try to complete the counting process through tabulation and verification.

translations.source: Kowane wajen bauta tana da budaden haraba tare da kebantaccen mihrabi wanda limamai kadai ke shiga.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each entrance is secured with a heavy gate and a lock, which is only accessible to teachers.

translations.source: Wasu lokuta an gina hasumiya na musamman mai siffar dala, wanda ake kira ziggurats, domin su zama sashi na haikali.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: In some cases, special buildings with dollar-shaped designs, known as cathedrals, were constructed as places of worship.

translations.source: Saman hasumiyar wuri ne na musamman na abun bautan.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: Saman is a special area for the purpose of construction.

translations.source: A cikin yanayi mai zafi na Gabas ta tsakiya, gida ba shi da matuƙar mahimmanci.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the hot climate of Central Africa, a house is not a particularly important thing.

translations.source: Yawancin rayuwar dangin Ibrananci sun faru ne a sararin sama.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the life cycle of the Ibrananci occurs in the air.

translations.source: Mata sun yi girki a farfajiyar; shagunan buɗe ido ne kawai suna kallon titi. An yi amfani da dutse don gina gidaje.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: The houses were built on the beach; they were simple structures with open windows, overlooking the sea. Bricks were used to construct the buildings.

translations.source: Babu wani daji mai girma a ƙasar Kan'ana, saboda haka katako yana da tsada.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There are no large rivers in the country of Canaan, so the land is dry and the crops are poor.

translations.source: An zauna a Greenland a warwatse. A cikin yankin Norse sun ce an kori Erik the Red daga Iceland saboda kisan kai, kuma lokacin da ya kaɗa ya yi yamma, sai ya gano Greenland kuma ya ba ta suna Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland due to his violent behavior. When he sailed west, he discovered Greenland and named it Greenland.

translations.source: Amma duk da ganowar sa, dama tuni ƙabilun Eskimo suna zaune a wurin a lokacin.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: However, despite this, the Inuit people had already settled in the area at that time.

translations.source: Kodayake kowace ƙasa ta kasance 'Scandinavia', akwai bambance-bambance masu yawa tsakanin mutane, sarakuna, al'adu da tarihin Denmark, Sweden, Norway da Iceland.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Although all these countries are considered "Scandinavia," there are significant differences between the people, culture, government, and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Iceland.

translations.source: Idan ka kalli majigi mai suna National Treasure, za ka yi tsamanin an rubuta taswirar taska a bayan takardan Ƙudurin ‘Yancin Kai.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you look at a painting called "National Treasure," you will notice that the portrait depicts a scene related to the concept of self-determination.

translations.source: Sai dai kuma, wannan ba gaskiya ba ne. Duk da cewa akwai wani abu da aka rubuta a bayan daftarin, ba taswirar taskar arziki ba ce.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, this is not accurate. While there is a note on the back of the document, it does not depict the actual business transaction.

translations.source: An rubuta a bayan Bayanin Samun Ƴancin kai kalmomin “Asalin Sanarwar Samun' Yanci ne a ranar 4 ga Yuli 1776”. Rubutun ya bayyana a ƙasan takardar, juye.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The note is located at the bottom of the document titled "Declaration of Independence," dated July 4, 1776. The note is found at the bottom of the document, on the verso (back) side.

translations.source: A yayin da babu takamaiman wanda ya rubuta shi, an sani cewa a farkon rayuwar shi, babban takardan (yana daukar ma'aunin inci 29¾ zuwa inci 24½) an nada shi don ajiya.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: Although there is no definitive author, it is known that in its early days, a large, rectangular manuscript (measuring approximately 29¾ to 24½ inches) was used for storage.

translations.source: Don haka, da alama an ƙara tsarin rubutun ne kawai a matsayin laƙabi.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, it seems that the writing style was only used as a formality.

translations.source: Saukar D-Day da yaƙe-yaƙe masu zuwa sun ƴantar da arewacin Faransa, amma har yanzu kudanci bai sami yanci ba.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The D-Day landings and subsequent fighting in the north of France have had a significant impact, but the region remains under German control.

translations.source: Faransawa '' Vichy '' suka mallake shi. Waɗannan mutanen Faransa ne waɗanda suka yi sulhu da Jamusawa a 1940 kuma suka yi aiki tare da masu mamaye maimakon yaƙar su.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: The "Vichy" French, who had allied themselves with Germany in 1940 and collaborated with the occupying forces instead of resisting them.

translations.source: A ranar 15 ga watan Agusta 1940, Kawayen sun mamaye kudancin Faransa, mamayar da aka yi wa lakabi da sunan “Operation Dragoon”.
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15, 1940, Allied forces launched an invasion of southern France, an operation known as "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: A cikin makonni biyu kawai Amurkawa da Sojojin Faransa na ƴancin faransa suka ƴantar da kudancin Faransa kuma suka juya zuwa Jamus.
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: In just two weeks, American and French troops had advanced south through France and were heading towards Germany.

translations.source: Wayewa al’ada ce guda wadda mutane da dama da ke zama da aiki tare na daukan nasu ce, al’umma.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: Teamwork is a practice where people who work together share success and achievements.

translations.source: Kalmar civilization ta zo ne daga kalmar latin civilis, ma’ana farar hula, mai dangantaka da civis na Latin, ma’ana yan kasa, da cavitas, ma’ana birni ko birnin-jiha, kuma yana ba da adadin yawan jama’a.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word "civilization" comes from the Latin word "civilis," which means "of the people" or "of the citizens," and is related to "civis," which means "citizen" or "town," and "cavitas," which means "city" or "urban area," and also refers to the population size.

translations.source: Biranen gari sune kashin bayan al'ummomi. Al'adar wayewar tana nuna wucewar ilimi a cikin tsararraki da yawa, rabe-raben al'adu da rarraba gaskiya.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: Markets are the heart of communities. The tradition of bartering demonstrates the exchange of knowledge and skills among diverse groups, fostering social connections and the sharing of information.

translations.source: kananun al’adu galibi su kan shuɗe ba tare da barin tabbatattun shaidu na tarihi ba kuma ba a saka su cikin jerin manyan zamunna.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: Many traditional customs often lack concrete historical evidence and are not included in our major historical narratives.

translations.source: A lokacin Yaƙin Juyin Juya Hali, jihohi goma sha ukun sun kafa gwamnatin tsakiya mai rauni - wadda ta kunshi Majalisa kawai - a ƙarƙashin dokar gwamnatin hadin gwiwa.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the Civil War, seven states established a unified government – consisting only of a legislature – under the principle of united government.

translations.source: Majalisa ba ta da wani iko na kakaba haraji, sannan kuma, kasancewar babu ɓangarorin zartaswa da na shari’a na ƙasar, ta dogara ne kan hukumomin jihohi, waɗanda mafi yawanci ba sa bayar da haɗin kai, wajen ganin an tilasta aiki da dokokin.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The legislature does not have the power to override state laws, and the absence of a strong federal judiciary means that states are largely responsible for enforcing the laws.

translations.source: Hakanan ba ta da ikon yin watsi da dokokin haraji da haraji tsakanin jihohi.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: She also lacks the power to disregard inter-state tax and levy regulations.

translations.source: Labaran sun buƙaci yarjejeniya baki ɗaya daga dukkan jihohin kafin a iya gyara su kuma jihohi sun ɗauki gwamnatin tarraya a sauƙaƙe cewa wakilansu ba su nan.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: The reports indicated a need for a single, unified agreement from all states before any repairs could be made, but the states had failed to reach such an agreement, with representatives from some states claiming they were not present.

translations.source: Masu kwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Italiya, tare da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Jamus ita ce ta biyu mafi nasara a duniya kuma sun kasance zakarun ƙwallon ƙafa na FIFA a 2006.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: The Italian and German national football teams are the two most successful in the world, and they were both champions of the FIFA World Cup in 2006.

translations.source: Shahararrun wasanni sun hada da kwallon kafa, kwallon kwando, wasan kwallon raga, wasan ruwa, wasan takobi, wasan kwallon rugby, tseren kekuna, kwallon gora, wasan kwallon gorar kankara da na tseren motoci na F1.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include football, basketball, soccer, water sports, track and field, rugby, cycling, and motor racing, including Formula 1.

translations.source: Wasannin hunturu sun shahara a yankuna na Arewa, inda da Italiyawa su ke fafatawa a wasannin kasa da kasa da wasannin Olympic.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: Football has become popular in northern regions, where it is played both domestically and in international competitions, including the Olympic Games.

translations.source: Japans suna riƙe da kusan tsibirai 7,000 (babba shine Honshu), yana mai sanya Japan tsibiri na 7 mafi girma a duniya!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan has approximately 6,852 islands (the largest being Honshu), making it the seventh-largest country in the world by land area!

translations.source: Saboda tari/rukunin tsibirai da Japan ke da su, sau da yawa akan kira Japan, a matsayin yanki, da suna “tarin tsibirai”.
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to Japan's rich history and culture, it is often referred to as the "Land of the Rising Sun".

translations.source: Farkon Taiwan ya faro tun baya cikin karni na 15 inda Turawa matukan jirgin ruwa da ke wucewa suka ɗauki sunan tsibirin a matsayin IIha Formosa, ko kyakyawan tsibiri.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: The initial contact between Taiwan and Europeans dates back to the 15th century, when Portuguese sailors encountered the island and named it Ilha Formosa, or "Beautiful Island."

translations.source: A cikin 1624, Kamfanin Dutch East India Company ya kafa tushe a kudu maso yammacin Taiwan, yana ƙaddamar da canji a cikin ayyukan noman hatsi na asali da ɗaukar ma'aikata na China don yin aiki a gonakin shinkafa da sukari.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a presence in southern western Taiwan, initiating a shift in agricultural practices from traditional farming to the cultivation of sugar cane and the employment of Chinese laborers in the sugar plantations.

translations.source: A shekarar 1683, sojojin daular Qing (1644-1912) sun kwace ikon lardin Taiwan na yammacin da arewacin gabar teku, suka ayyana Taiwan a matsayin lardin daular Qing a shekarar 1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, Qing Dynasty troops (1644-1912) seized control of the western and northern parts of Taiwan, and in 1885, Taiwan was declared a province of the Qing Dynasty.

translations.hypothesis: In 1895, following the end of the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki, which ceded control of Taiwan to Japan. Japan ruled the island until 1945.

translations.source: Ƙasar China ta zamanin da tana da wata hanyar musamman ta nuna lokutan yanayi daban-daban; kowane mataki na China ko kowane iyali da ya hau karagar mulki to shi ma daula ce ta daban.

translations.hypothesis: The Great Leap Forward was a disastrous economic and social campaign in China during the 1950s and 1960s. It resulted in widespread famine and the deaths of millions of people.

translations.source: Akwai tasiri na zamantakewa da siyasa masu yawa kamar amfani da tsarin awo cikakke, barin kama-karya zuwa jamhuriyya, kishin ƙasa tare da imanin cewa ƙasar ta mutanen ƙasa ce ba mutum ɗaya mai mulki ba.

translations.source: Wanzuwar Fasahar Ƙere-ƙere al’amari ne da ya haɗo wani faffaɗan fage na ra’ayoyi a aikace, daga bunƙasar fasaha ko muhimmancin fasahar ƙere-ƙere zuwa ga haƙiƙanin sanin cewa makomar dan adam tana tafiya ne bisa tabbatacciyar hikima wadda ke da alaƙa da dokokin kimiyya da kuma bayyanar su a cikin fasahar ƙere-ƙere.
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.hypothesis: Computational science is a field that combines various disciplines, from the fundamental principles of computer science to the practical applications of computational methods. It explores the use of computers to solve complex problems in a wide range of fields, including mathematics, physics, engineering, and biology.

translations.source: Yawancin fassarar tabbatuwar fasahar zamani sun kunshi ra’ayi mafiya yaduwa guda biyu: cewa na fasaha ita kanta na bin tafarki wacce ta sha bamban da tasirin al’ada ko siyasa da kuma cewa fasaha nada “tasiri” ga al’umma masu asali, fiye da na tsarin yanayin zamantakewa.
translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.hypothesis: Most contemporary interpretations of technology focus on two main ideas: that technology itself is a force that evolves independently of social or political influences, and that technology has a direct "impact" on societies, rather than simply being a reflection of existing social structures.

translations.source: Misali, mutum na iya cewa motar tilas ba zata haifar da ci gaban hanyoyi ba.
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.hypothesis: For example, a person might say that a car cannot contribute to the development of roads.

translations.source: Koyaya, hanyar sadarwa ta ƙasa gabaɗaya ba ta da tasirin tattalin arziƙi don ƙarancin motoci, saboda haka ana ƙirƙirar sabbin hanyoyin samarwa don rage farashin mallakar mota.
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.hypothesis: Generally, road transportation is not as effective for economic development due to the limited number of vehicles, which is why new methods of transportation are being developed to reduce the cost of owning a car.

translations.source: Hakanan mallakar motoci da yawa yana haifar da yawan hadari a kan hanyoyi, wanda ke haifar da kirkirar sabbin dabaru a fannin kiwon lafiya don gyaran jikin da ya lalace.
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, the widespread use of vehicles contributes to increased traffic congestion, which in turn leads to the creation of new health hazards due to accidents and injuries.

translations.source: Tsarin fasaha da adabi samar da al’adu, wanda marubuta irinsu Gothe, Fichte da Schlegel su ka samar.
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: This literary and artistic movement, exemplified by figures like Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel, aimed to create a new aesthetic and cultural identity.

translations.source: A cikin siyakin romanci, yanayin kasa ya canza mutane, kuma lokaci da yawa sai al'adu da al'adu masu alaƙa da wannan yanayin suka taso, kuma waɗannan, kasancewar suna jituwa da matsayin jama'a, sun fi ƙa'idodi da aka kafa bisa doka da oda.
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.hypothesis: In the context of the novel, the changing social landscape has led to shifts in people's attitudes and behaviors, and as a result, new customs and traditions have emerged that often clash with established legal and social norms.

translations.source: Kamar yadda aka san Paris da babban birnin salon zamani na duniyar yau, ana ɗaukar Constantinople a matsayin babban birni na zamani na Turai.
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.hypothesis: As Paris is widely recognized as the center of modern fashion, Constantinople is considered the center of modern art in Europe.

translations.source: Shaharar ta na kasancewa cibiyar jin daɗi ya fara ne a kusan shekara ta 400 A.D. kuma ya kai har kusan 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: Its popularity began around the 4th century AD and continued until approximately the 11th century AD.

translations.source: Matsayinta ya yi kasa a ƙarni na goma sha biyu musamman sakamakon dawowar mayakan jihadin kuros dauke da kyaututtuka irin su siliki da kayan ɗanɗanon abinci waɗanda ake ɗauka da daraja fiye da abubuwan da ake sayarwa a kasuwannin Daular Rum.
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.hypothesis: The empire experienced a decline in the 18th century, particularly due to the rise of piracy, which involved the seizure of valuable goods such as silk and spices, which were more highly valued than the goods traded in the Ottoman markets.

translations.source: A wannan lokacin ne sauya mukamin na Kawar Babban Birni daga Constantinople zuwa Paris ya faru.
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.hypothesis: At this time, the relocation of the capital from Constantinople to Paris took place.

translations.source: Tsarin Gothic ya yi shura a tsakankanin karni na 10 zuwa na 11 da kuma karni na 14.
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.hypothesis: The Gothic style flourished during the 10th to 11th centuries and again in the 14th century.

translations.source: A farkon lamari, kabilar Byzantine da ke gabashi ta karfafa saka tufafi.
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the Byzantine Empire was known for its elaborate clothing styles.

translations.source: Koyaya, saboda saurin tashoshin sadarwa, salo a yamma na iya zama baya zuwa shekara 25 zuwa 30.
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.hypothesis: However, due to the rapid pace of technological advancements, the lifespan of mobile phones can range from 2 to 3 years.

translations.source: a karshen karnin tsakiya sashin nahiyar turai na yamma ta fara bunkasa nata tsarin. Daya daga cikin abubuwan da aka gina a wannan lokacin da taimakon ‘yan jihadi shine fara amfani da anini don rike riga.
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.hypothesis: As the central Asian region of Eastern Europe began to develop its own distinct identity, one of the key developments was the adoption of ironworking techniques. This allowed for the production of tools and weapons, which were essential for both agriculture and warfare.

translations.source: Noma domin abinci shine tsarin noma wanda ake yinsa domin kawai a samar da abincin da zai wadatar da mutum da iyalansa.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.hypothesis: Subsistence farming is a type of agriculture where the primary goal is to produce food for the farmer's own family.

translations.source: Noma domin abinci kawai abu ne mai sauki, sau da yawa, ana amfani da iri na shuka wanda ya dace da kasar noman wajen, tare da sauya abin shuka duk shekara a gona guda, domin samun cikakkiyar yabanya.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.hypothesis: Crop farming is a relatively simple and widespread practice, utilizing locally available seeds and techniques, with crops rotated annually to maintain soil fertility.

translations.source: A tarihance mafi yawan manoma sun kasance suna aikin noma kuma wannan har yanzu haka lamarin yake a yawancin ƙasashe masu tasowa.
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, agriculture has been the primary occupation for many people, and this remains the case in many developing countries.
