translations.source: Rassan al’adu suna sada mutane masu tunani iri daya da suke ji tsarin rayuwa na al’umma bai dace da su ba inda suke ba su damar ganin suna da muhimanci a al’umma.
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.hypothesis: These types of people often clash with others who have different views and feel that the prevailing social norms do not suit them, leading to a sense of alienation and a feeling that they are not valued in society.

translations.source: Ana iya bambanta kananan al’adu saboda shekara, bangarenci na jama’a, matsayi cikin al’umma, guri, da/ko kuma jintsin membobi.
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.hypothesis: Differences in customs can arise due to factors such as year, social class, position in society, location, and/or family ties.

translations.source: Kyawawan siffofin da suke tabbatar da wata ƙaramar al’ada a matsayin wadda ta fita daban kan iya kasancewa na yare, kyau, addini, siyasa, jinsi, na yanki, ko hadin abubuwa.
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.hypothesis: Distinctive features that can help identify a particular tradition as unique can include language, customs, religion, politics, ethnicity, geography, or a combination of these elements.

translations.source: Membobin masana'antar sau da yawa suna nuna alamar kasancewa memba ta hanyar rarrabe mai amfani da alama ta salon, wanda ya haɗa da salon, halayen kirki, da ɗaukar hoto.
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.hypothesis: Members of the association demonstrate their membership through a common identifier, such as a logo, slogan, and photograph.

translations.source: Daya daga cikin matakan da ake amfani dashi domin nuna muhimmacin zamantakewa shine nuna kadan daga cikin hali na takaici wanda yara suka fuskanta, ta hanyar sakaci, masifa, ko cin zarafi, kuma basu zamantakewa da manya ba yayin da suke girma.
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.hypothesis: One of the ways to demonstrate the importance of social development is to highlight the challenges that children face, such as poverty, violence, or neglect, and to show how social programs can help them overcome these obstacles and grow up in a supportive environment.

translations.source: Ana kiran irin waɗannan yaran “sakakku” ko masu wuyar juyawa. Mutane sun sha kulle waɗansu sakakkun yara (yawanci iyayensu ne); a wasu al’amuran kuma barin yaran na da alaƙa da ƙin amincewar iyaye da naƙasar basira ko ta jikin yaro.
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.hypothesis: These children are often referred to as "sakakku" or "troublemakers." They are typically neglected or abandoned by their parents; in some cases, their situation is due to parental neglect, abuse, or a lack of proper care.

translations.source: Yaran mara zuciya masu jin tsoro na iya fuskantar mummunan cin zarafin yara ko rauni kafin a watsar da su ko su gudu.
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.hypothesis: Children who are victims of trafficking or abuse may experience severe physical or psychological harm before they are rescued or escape.

translations.source: Wasu ana zargin dabbobi ne suka yi rainon su; an ce wasu sun yi rayuwa a daji da kansu.
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.hypothesis: Some people believe that animals are capable of experiencing emotions; others claim that they live solely on instinct.

translations.source: Idan ya kasance dabbar da ba mutum bace ta raini yaro gaba daya, zai kasance yaro zai taso da (na zihiri) kusan duka irin suffar dabi'un dabbar da ta kula dashi,misali irin yadda yake tsoro da rashin ko-in kula ga sauran mutane.
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.hypothesis: If a non-human creature, such as a dog, is seen alone, the child will likely perceive it as a solitary being, similar to how they might perceive a person who is isolated or withdrawn from others.

translations.source: Duk da yake tushen koyo game da aiki yakamata ya sauƙaƙa ilmantarwa kuma ya zama mai ban sha'awa, ƙwanƙwasa aiki ya wuce mataki.
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.hypothesis: While the goal of education is to make learning enjoyable and engaging, the reality of the workplace often falls short.

translations.source: Nannadewa ba hanya ce ta ilmantarwa ba amma taimako ne wanda ke bayar da tallafi ga mutanen da ke fuskantar sabon ƙwarewar ilmantarwa kamar amfani da sabon shirin komputa ko fara sabon aiki.
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.hypothesis: Nannadewa is not just a way to learn, but also a supportive resource for individuals who are facing new challenges in education, such as using new computer programs or starting a new job.

translations.source: Scafflods zasu iya zama na gaske da kuma virtual, a wasu kalaman, malami wani bangare ne na scafflod amma hakanan ma dan karamin abun makale takarda a microsoft office.
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: Scaffolds can be both physical and virtual. In some cases, a scaffold is a physical structure, but in others, it can also refer to a template or placeholder in Microsoft Office.

translations.source: Ana saka kariya cikin manhajojin domin su yi tambaya, su yi nuni da bada bayanai wadanda dalibai su kadai ba za su iya fuskanta ba.
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.hypothesis: Safeguards are implemented in methods to ensure that students are the only ones who can ask questions, provide answers, and access information.

translations.source: Ana sanya yara a Gidan Reno saboda dalilai masu yawa da suka hada da sakaci, zin zarafi, har ma zuwa ƙwace.
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.hypothesis: Children are placed in the Reno Home for a variety of reasons, including abuse, neglect, and even abandonment.

translations.source: Bai kamata a ce akwai yaron da zai girma a cikin muhallin da babu reno, kulawa da kuma almantarwa, amma suna yi.
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.hypothesis: It is possible for a child to grow up in an environment lacking proper care, education, and guidance, but still succeed.

translations.source: Mun fahimci Tsarin Kulawa na jarirai ya zama yankin aminci ga waɗannan yara.
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.hypothesis: We understand that the childcare program has become a safe haven for these children.

translations.source: Ya kamata tsarinmu na karɓar riko ya samar da gidaje masu aminci, masu reno da ke nuna soyayya, ingantaccen ilimi, da tabbataccen tsarin kulawa da lafiya.
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.hypothesis: Our system for providing care should create safe, nurturing environments that promote love, provide quality education, and ensure proper healthcare.

translations.source: Yakamata renon yara ya samar da dukkan bukatu wadanda su ke da bukatu a gidan da aka dauko su.
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.hypothesis: The baby's needs are all met by the things provided in the house where he was raised.

translations.source: Yanar gizo ta hada abubuwa biyu na sadarwar tsakanin al’umma da daidaikun mutane.
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.hypothesis: The internet encompasses two main forms of communication between people: interpersonal and mass communication.

translations.source: Kyakyawan halaye na intanet suna haifar da karin girma dangane da matakan gamsarwa.
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.hypothesis: The rise of the internet has led to increased competition in the field of customer service.

translations.source: Alal misali, “koyo” da “cudanya” ana kallonsu a matsayin muhimman hanyoyin ƙarfafa yin amfani da yanar gizo (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: For example, terms like "koyo" and "cudanya" are considered important methods for promoting the use of the internet (James et al., 1995).

translations.source: “Shiga cikin mutum” da “ci gaba da dangantaka” na cikin sabbin fannonin kwarin gwiwa ta Eighmey da McCord (1998) yayinda suka bincika daukin masu sauraro a gidajen yanar gizo.
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.hypothesis: "Engagement" and "continued interaction" are key concepts in the research of Eighmey and McCord (1998), which examines user behavior on websites.

translations.source: Amfani da rikodin bidiyo ya haifar da bincike mai mahimmanci a cikin fassara bayanan fuska, motsin fuska waɗanda ba sa wuce lokaci ƙalilan.
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.hypothesis: The use of video analysis has led to significant advancements in facial recognition and motion capture technology, enabling the tracking of subtle facial movements over very short periods.

translations.source: Musamman ma kamar, ikirarin da ya yi cewa zai gano ko mutum yana karyar fassarar/fahimtar kananan maganganu yadda suke.
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.hypothesis: Specifically, the claim that the system can identify whether a person is understanding the meaning of individual words.

translations.source: A cikin takardar shi mai take Jawabin Shugaba Oliver Sacks ya bayyana yadda mutane dake fuskantar masala wajen fahimtar jawabi bisa ga masalar tabin kwakwalwa, yace duk da haka suna iya fahimtar gaskiya daidai.
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.hypothesis: In his letter, Dr. Oliver Sacks explains how people who are deaf can still understand spoken language, despite the challenges they face. He argues that they are capable of understanding the truth and meaning of what is being said.

translations.source: Har ma yana ba da shawarar cewa irin waɗannan damar a fassara halayen mutane za su iya rabawa ta dabbobi kamar su karnukan gida.
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.hypothesis: It also suggests that these opportunities to observe human behavior could be replicated in animals, such as domestic animals.

translations.source: Binciken ƙarni na ashirin ya nuna cewa akwai rabe-raben halittar gado guda biyu: ɓoyayye da na bayyananne.
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.hypothesis: A comprehensive study of the 20th century revealed two distinct types of bed: the traditional and the modern.

translations.source: Maye gurbi yana ƙara sabon bambancin kwayoyin, kuma zaɓi ya cire shi daga tafkin bambancin da aka bayyana.
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.hypothesis: The new layer of sediment is adding to the overall thickness, and the choice to remove it from the stratigraphic sequence.

translations.source: Rabuwa da sake haduwa iri dabam-dabam baya da gaba tsakanin gidan ruwan guda biyu a kowace karni.
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.hypothesis: The relationship between two adjacent wells has varied significantly over time.

translations.source: A can cikin yankin savanna, yana da wahala ga wata halitta dangin biri da ke da tsarin narkewar abinci irin na mutum ta iya gamsar da buƙatunta na sinadarin amino daga albarkatun tsirrai da ake da su.
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.hypothesis: In the savanna region, a type of grass that produces seeds similar to those of humans faces a challenge in meeting its amino acid needs.

translations.source: Bugu da ƙari, ƙin yin hakan yana tattare da munanan sakamako:kamar rashin yin girma, rashin abinci mai gina jiki, da kuma a karshe mutuwa.
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, neglecting these basic needs leads to dire consequences: stunted growth, malnutrition, and ultimately, death.

translations.source: Ma’dinan tsirrai da aka fi saurin amfani da su sun kasance sunadaran gina jiki da za'a iya samu a ganye da ƙwaya, amma waɗannan suna da tauri ga halittu irin mu wajen narkewa har sai an dafa su.
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.hypothesis: The most commonly used spices are those that can be easily obtained from plants and herbs, but they need to be cooked before being used.

translations.source: Sabanin haka, abincin dabbobi (tururuwa, gara, ƙwai) ba kawai ana iya narkewa cikin sauƙi ba, amma suna samar da sunadarai masu yawa waɗanda ke ɗauke da dukkan muhimman amino acid.
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, animal products (meat, fish, eggs) are not only easy to cook, but they also provide a wide range of nutrients, including all the essential amino acids.

translations.source: In an yi la’akari da dukkan abubuwa, bai kamata mu yi mamaki ba idan magabatanmu suka magance “matsalar kayan gina jiki” ta irin hanyar da goggon biri a yankin savanna suke yi a yau.
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.hypothesis: Considering all the factors, it is unlikely that our buildings will be affected by the type of construction techniques used by builders in the savanna region today.

translations.source: Katse bacci yanayi ne na farkawa da gangan cikin lokacin yin bacci na al’ada da kuma komawa bacci cikin dan kaknkanin lokaci daga baya (minti 10-60).
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.hypothesis: Katse is a type of sleep behavior that involves abruptly waking up from sleep and then immediately falling back asleep (lasting between 10 and 60 minutes).

translations.source: Za'a iya yin wannan a saukake ta hanyar amfani da kararrawa mara kara sosai da zai tashe ka ba tare da ya wartsakar da kai ba.
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.hypothesis: This can be done easily by using a simple, non-stick pan that won't stick to the food.

translations.source: Idan ka sami kanka ka sake saita agogo a cikin barcinka, ana iya sanya shi a ɗaya gefen ɗakin, yana tilasta ka tashi daga kan gado don kashe shi.
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.hypothesis: If you find that the light switch in your bedroom is not working, you may need to replace the bulb. This can be done by simply unscrewing the old bulb and screwing in a new one.

translations.source: Sauran zabukan da suka danganta da lissafin ɗabi’ar rayuwa sun kunshi shan kayan ruwa da yawa (musamman ruwa ko shayi, sanannen sinadari mai jawo fitsari) kafin barci, da ke tilastawa mutum ya tashi ya yi ftisari.
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.hypothesis: The recommended sleep hygiene practices include drinking plenty of fluids (especially water or herbal tea) before bed, and getting up to use the restroom.

translations.source: Yawan kwanciyar hankali da mutum yake da shi ya danganta da kishiyantar yawan tashin hankali a cikin jikin mutum da ruhunsa.
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.hypothesis: A person's level of concentration is related to their ability to focus their attention both physically and mentally.

translations.source: Rage tashin hankali, haka kuma yawan fata na gari da ƙarfin rayuwa zai gabatar. Ko wani mutum na da damar samun kwanciyar hankali da gamsuwa.
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.hypothesis: Anger can lead to loss of focus, as well as increased irritability and aggression. It is important to find healthy ways to manage anger and express emotions.

translations.source: Kowa zai iya cimma wayewa. Abinda kawai ke tsaye kan hanyar wannan burin shine tashin hankali da fargaba.
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone can achieve success. The only obstacle is distraction and doubt.

translations.source: Buddhist na Tibet ya dogara ne da koyarwar Buddha, amma hanyar mahayana da ta hanyar fasahar India da yawa sun ninka ta.
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.hypothesis: Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of the Buddha, but it has been influenced by both the Mahayana tradition of India and other Buddhist schools.

translations.source: A bisa ƙa’ida Budancin Tibet yana da sauƙi. Ya kunshi tsarin motsa jiki na Yoga, kadaicewa domin tunani da kuma bin tafarkin son kowa da komai.
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.hypothesis: According to tradition, Tibetan Buddhism is simple. It involves physical postures of yoga, meditation, and following the path of compassion and loving-kindness.

translations.source: Da Kundalini Yoga an samar da kuzarin Kundalini (kuzarin wayarwa da kai) an farka ta hanyar motsawar jiki, motsawar nufanci, mantras da ganin wa.
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.hypothesis: Through Kundalini Yoga, the Kundalini energy (the energy of awakening) is awakened through physical movement, breathwork, mantras, and visualization.

translations.source: Ginshiƙen tunanun Tibetan shi ne Abin Bauta Yoga. Duk da yake kafafen gani na abubuwan bauta daban-daban hanyoyin makamashi an tsaftace su, akan buɗe chakras inda ake ƙirƙirar tunanin wayewa.
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.hypothesis: The core concept of Tibetan Buddhism is Clear Light Yoga. While different forms of meditation utilize various techniques, Clear Light Yoga focuses on opening the chakras to create a state of effortless awareness.

translations.source: Jamus abokiyar gabar kowa ce a Yakin Duniya ta 2, wanda hakan ta haifar da haɗin kai tsakanin Tarayyar Sobiyet da Amurka. Da ƙarewar yakin sai sabanin tsarin rayuwa, al’amura da al'adu ya jawo rabuwar kan ƙasashen.
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.hypothesis: The Second World War was a global conflict that involved most of the world’s countries. It resulted in a major shift in global power dynamics, with the Soviet Union and the United States emerging as the dominant superpowers. After the war, the world experienced a period of significant social and cultural change, leading to divisions between countries.

translations.source: Tare da shekaru biyu na ƙarshen yaƙin, tsoffin maƙasudin yanzu abokan gaba ne kuma aka fara Yakin Sanyi.
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.hypothesis: Two years after the end of the war, the former combatants have now become peacekeepers, and the peace process has begun.

translations.source: An tsara zai kai shekaru 40 masu zuwa kuma za ayi yaƙe shi a hakika,ta sojojin haya, a filayen yaƙi daga Africa zuwa Asia, a Afghanistan, Cuba da sauran wurare da dama.
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.hypothesis: The plan is to send 40 soldiers on a mission, which will involve combat training in various locations, including Africa, Asia, Afghanistan, Cuba, and other areas.

translations.source: Ya zuwa 17 ga Satumba, 1939, tsaron Poland ya riga ya karye, kuma fatan kawai da ake da shi shine na janyewa sannan a sake shiri a kan tozon gadar Romania.
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.hypothesis: By September 17, 1939, Polish forces had already been defeated, and the only hope left was to evacuate the remaining population and withdraw to the border with Romania.

translations.source: Koda yake wannan shiri ya tashi daga aiki dare ɗaya, yayin da sama da sojoji 800,000 na tarayyar Soviet su ka shiga Belarus da Ukraine inda su ka shata fagen daga bayan mamayar kasar Poland wanda ya karya yarjejeniyar sulhu da aka yi a Riga, sulhu zaman lafiya na kasashen Soviet da Poland da ma wasu yarjeniyoyin na kasashen duniya tsakanin kasarshe biyu ko fiye da haka.
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, this attack occurred during the night, as over 800,000 Soviet troops invaded Belarus and Ukraine, aiming to seize control of the territory following the occupation of Poland, which had broken the peace treaty signed in Riga, establishing a lasting peace between the Soviet Union and Poland, as well as other international agreements between the two countries.

translations.source: Amfani da jirgin ruwa domin kwasan kayayyaki shine mafi inganci wajen kwasan mutane da yawa da kayayyaki ta teku.
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.hypothesis: Using water transport for cargo is the most efficient way to transport large quantities of goods and people.

translations.source: Ainihin aikin sojojin ruwa shine domin tabbatar cewa kasarka ta kula da iyawa domin motsa mutanenka da kayayyaki, yayinda kuma a lokaci daya, tsoma baki da kokarin da abokan gaba ke yi domin tafiyar da mutane da kayayyaki.
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.hypothesis: The primary function of naval forces is to ensure that your country can effectively transport people and goods, while also keeping a watchful eye on potential threats to maritime traffic.

translations.source: Daya daga cikin fitattun misalai na kwana nan game da wannan shine gumurzun yankin Atlantika ta Arewa lokacin Yakin Duniya na biyu. Amurkawa suna ƙoƙarin jigilar da sojoji da kayan yaki zuwa ƙetarenTekun Atlantika don taimakawa Biritaniya.
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most significant events of World War II in this region was the Battle of the Atlantic. The Allies were trying to transport troops and supplies across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.

translations.source: A lokaci daya, dakarun ruwa na Jamus, ta hanyar amfani da jirgin U-boats, na kokarin tsayar da wannan cinkoson.
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.hypothesis: At one point, German naval forces, using U-boats, attempted to break the British blockade.

translations.source: Da Sojan taron dangi ba su yi nasara ba, watakila da Jamus ta iya yi mamaye Biritaniya kamar ta sauran Turai.
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.hypothesis: Although the Franco-Prussian War ended in a victory for France, it is possible that Germany could have defeated Britain in a similar conflict.

translations.source: Ana ganin akuya ta kasance gida ta farko kusan shekaru 10,000 da suka gabata a tsaunukan Zagros na Iran.
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.hypothesis: It is believed that the oldest known evidence of human habitation dates back approximately 10,000 years, found in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

translations.source: Al’adu da ƙabilun zamanin da ne su ka fara adana su domin sauƙin samun madara, gashi, nama, da kuma fatu.
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.hypothesis: The traditions and customs that were established by different communities over time were primarily aimed at making it easier to obtain food, such as grains, livestock, and other essential resources.

translations.source: A koyaushe ana ajiye awakin gida a cikin garken shanun da ke yawo a kan tsaunuka ko wasu wuraren kiwo, galibi masu kiwon awaki waɗanda yara da samari ne ke kula da su, kwatankwacin sanannen makiyayi. Wadannan hanyoyin kiwo har yanzu ana amfani dasu.
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.hypothesis: Traditional terraced farms are typically located on hillsides or other elevated areas, often cultivated by local farmers who are well-versed in the specific techniques. These farming methods are still widely used today.

translations.source: An samar da layukan tarago a Ingila tun a wajejen Ƙarni na 16.
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.hypothesis: The development of railway systems in England began in the 16th century.

translations.source: Duk da cewa keken dokin sun kunshi katako a jere, amma su kan ba da dama ga dawakan da ke jan su yin sauri tare da jan manyan kaya fiye da a kan hanyoyi masu gargada na zamanin.
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.hypothesis: Although bicycles are relatively inexpensive, they offer a faster and more efficient mode of transportation compared to traditional methods, especially for carrying heavy goods on established roads.

translations.source: An sanya Crossties tun da wuri don su tsayar layukan. Sai dai, hankali, an gano cewa layukan za su fi dacewa idan suna da ɗori na ƙarfe a saman su.
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.hypothesis: Cross ties are placed at intervals to keep the rails aligned. However, it has been found that the rails are more stable when they have a steel plate on top of them.

translations.source: Wannan ya zama aikin gama gari, sai ƙarfe ya haifar da ƙarin lalacewa a ƙafafun katako na kekunan.
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.hypothesis: This resulted in widespread damage, with iron causing further deterioration of the wooden frames of the bicycles.

translations.source: Daga karshe, an sauya tayoyin katako da na karfe. A cikin 1767 an kaddamar da farkon hanyar jirgin kasa kerar karfe.
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, the coal mines and forests were exploited. In 1767, the first railway line was established, using coal as fuel.

translations.source: Hanyar sufuri ta farko da aka sani ita ce tafiya da ƙafa, mutane sun fara tafiya a miƙe shekaru miliyan biyu da suka gabata lokacin bayyanawar Homo Erectus (ma'ana miƙaƙƙen mutum).
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.hypothesis: The earliest known form of transportation was walking, and humans began walking upright approximately two million years ago, during the emergence of Homo erectus (the upright man).

translations.source: Magabatan su, Australopithecus ba su yi tafiya miƙe ba kamar yadda ya ke a ɗabi’ance.
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.hypothesis: According to scientists, Australopithecus did not walk upright like modern humans.

translations.source: An sami kwarewar dabbobi masu tafiya da kafafu biyu a ƙasusuwan tarihi na Australopithecus daga shekaru miliyan 4.2-3.9 da suka shude, duk da cewa watakila Sahelanthropus sun yi tafiya da kafafu biyu tun wajen shekaru miliyan bakwai da suka gabata.
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.hypothesis: Evidence of bipedalism (walking on two legs) in the fossil remains of Australopithecus dates back to between 4.2 and 3.9 million years ago, although it is possible that Sahelanthropus may have also walked on two legs as far back as seven million years ago.

translations.source: Za mu iya fara zaman nuna sabo ga muhalli, za mu iya shiga cikin yunƙurin inganta muhalli, kuma mu kan iya zama ‘yan gwagwarmaya don rage wahala nan gaba a wani mataki.
translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.hypothesis: We can start by organizing a community clean-up event, participate in environmental protection efforts, and become advocates for reducing pollution in the future.

translations.source: Wannan kamar magani ne na alamun cuta a lokuta da yawa. Koyaya, idan ba kawai muna son magancewa ta ɗan lokaci ba ne, to ya kamata mu samo tushen matsalolin, kuma mu kashe su.
translations.reference: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.hypothesis: This is a common approach to treating cuts in many situations. However, if the goal is not just to provide temporary relief, it is important to identify and address the underlying cause of the cut.

translations.source: A bayyane ya ke cewa duniya ta canza sosai saboda ci gaban Dan Adam a fannonin kimiyya da fasaha, kuma matsaloli sun karu sosai sakamakon yawan jama’a da halayyar mutane ta almubazzaranci.
translations.reference: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.hypothesis: It is clear that the world has changed dramatically due to advancements in science and technology, and problems have increased significantly as a result of population growth and changing human behavior.

translations.source: Bayan Majalisar wakilai ta amince da shi a ranar 4 ta Yuli, sa'an nan aka aika wani daftarin da aka rubuta da hannu wanda Shugaban Majalisar John Hancock ya sa hannu da ɗan nesa zuwa ga shagon buga rubutu na John Dunlap.
translations.reference: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: Following the House of Representatives' approval on July 4th, a handwritten draft of the Declaration of Independence, signed by President of the House John Hancock and a delegate, was sent to John Dunlap, the printer.

translations.source: Cikin daren an buga tsakanin 150 da 200 wanda aka fi sani da “Dunlap Broadsides”.
translations.reference: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.hypothesis: The Dunlap Broadsides, a publication that appeared between 150 and 200 times, was widely circulated.

translations.source: John Nixon ne ya yi karatun farko na daftarin a bainar jama’a cikin filin Independence Hall a ranar 8 ga watan Yuli.
translations.reference: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.hypothesis: John Nixon completed his initial training at the public school located in Independence Hall on July 8th.

translations.source: An aika ma George Washington ɗaya a ranar 6 ga Yuli, wanda ya karanta ma sojojinsa a New York ranar 9 ga Yuli. Wani kwafi ya isa Landan a ranar 10 ga watan Agusta.
translations.reference: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.hypothesis: On July 4th, George Washington read a declaration to his troops in New York on July 9th. The declaration was officially adopted on August 2nd.

translations.source: Manyan bangarori 25 na Dunlap da har yanzu aka san sun wanzu sune mafi thufan kwafin rubutattun takardun. Kwafin rubutun hannun na asali ya salwanta.
translations.reference: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.hypothesis: The 25 original Dunlap broadsides, which are still considered to be among the most valuable printed documents, are in excellent condition. The original handwritten text is still legible.

translations.source: Yawancin masana burbushin halittu a yau sunyi imanin cewa ƙungiyar dinosaur daya ta rayu kuma tana raye a yau. Muna kiran su tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.hypothesis: Most paleontologists today believe that the dinosaur family still exists and is thriving today. We urge them to investigate further.

translations.source: Mutane da yawa basa tunanin cewa suna daga cikin halitun dinosaurs saboda suna da fiffike kuma suna iya tashi sama.
translations.reference: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.hypothesis: Many people don't believe they are dinosaurs because they have unique features and can fly.

translations.source: Amma akwai wasu abubuwa game da tsuntsuye dake kama da na dinosaur.
translations.reference: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: However, there are some extinct creatures that resemble dinosaurs.

translations.source: Suna da ƙafafu masu gurji-gurji da fartuna, suna yin ƙwai, kuma suna tafiya kan ƙafafunsu biyu na baya kamar wani T-Rex.
translations.reference: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: With their long necks and powerful legs, they move gracefully through the trees, and their two front legs resemble those of a T-Rex.

translations.source: Kusan duk kwamfutoci da ake amfani da su a yau sun dogara ne akan iya sarrafa bayanai wanda ake rufewa a sigar tagwayen lambobi.
translations.reference: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.hypothesis: Almost all modern computers rely on data storage in the form of magnetic strips.

translations.source: Lambar binary na iya samun ɗaya daga darajoji biyu, misali 0 ko 1, kuma waɗannan lambobin ana kiransu da lambobin binary - ko guntaye, in za a yi amfani da yaren kwamfuta.
translations.reference: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.hypothesis: A binary number can represent one of two values, for example, 0 or 1, and these numbers are called binary digits or bits.

translations.source: Harbuwa da guba a cikin jiki ba abu ne da ake iya ganewa da wuri ba. Alamu irinsu amai gama gari ne don haka ba a iya tantancewa da wurwuri.
translations.reference: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.hypothesis: The presence of pus inside the body is not something that can be easily detected. It is usually hidden, so it cannot be identified simply by looking.

translations.source: Hanya mafi saukin gane ko ana sami guba a ciki, shine watakila idan an sami budadden kwano na magani ko wasu sinadarai masu guba da ake amfanin yau da gobe da su a gida.
translations.reference: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.hypothesis: The most common way to obtain or find a source of fuel is perhaps by finding a supply of firewood or other combustible materials readily available at home.

translations.source: Duba bayanin da ke jiki domin samun bayanai na taimakon gaggawa agame da gubar.
translations.reference: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.hypothesis: Refer to the accompanying documentation for emergency contact information and first aid procedures.

translations.source: Likitocin dabbobi na amfani da kalmar bug wa wannan rukunin kwari.
translations.reference: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.hypothesis: The animal feed section uses the term "bug" to refer to this online platform.

translations.source: An samo kalmar tun zamanin da daga sanayyarsu da kudin cizo, wato wasu kwari da su ke zama muhallin mutane suna tsotsar jininsu.
translations.reference: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.hypothesis: The phrase refers to a time when their organization and resources were threatened, specifically due to the actions of individuals who were causing distress and disruption in the community.

translations.source: Duka kwarin mutuwa da kuma kudin cizo masu zaman gida ne, sun saba da zama a gidansu ko mazaunin wanda suke shan jininsa.
translations.reference: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.hypothesis: Both wild animals and domestic pets are capable of causing harm or death, and they can also be a source of stress and anxiety for their owners.

translations.source: A duk faɗin Amurka, akwai kusan rahoto 400,000 na cutar Multiple Sclerosis (MS), abinda ya sa ta zama ja-gaba cikin ciwukan sadarwa a jiki ga matasa da masu shekaru tsaka-tsaki.
translations.reference: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.hypothesis: Across the United States, there are approximately 400,000 people living with multiple sclerosis (MS), a condition that disrupts communication between nerve cells in the body, primarily affecting young adults and those in their prime.

translations.source: Cutar MS cuta ce da ke shafar lakkar jikin dan adam, da ya hadar da kwakwalwa da jijiyar lakkar da kuma na kai sakonni.
translations.reference: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.hypothesis: MS cut is a type of skin lesion that can affect people of all ages, and it can manifest as a variety of symptoms, including redness, swelling, and pain.

translations.source: Bincike ya gano cewa mata sun fi alamar samun MS da ninka biyu a kan maza.
translations.reference: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.hypothesis: The study found that women are more likely to experience both multiple sclerosis and kidney failure than men.

translations.source: Ma'aurata na iya yanke shawara cewa ba shine maslaharsu ba, ko maslaha ga ɗansu, tarbiyyar da jariri.
translations.reference: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.hypothesis: Parents may conclude that it is not in their best interest, or the best interest of their child, to pursue a particular education or career.

translations.source: Waɗannan ma'aurata na iya zaɓar yin shirin tallafi ga jaririn.
translations.reference: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.hypothesis: These devices can also be used to provide support for the body.

translations.source: A tsarin mallakar yaro, iyayen da suka haifi yaron za su dakatar da haƙƙinsu na iyaye saboda wasu ma'aurata su kasance iyayen sa.
translations.reference: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.hypothesis: In a controversial case, the parents who gave up their child to adoptive parents may find themselves forfeiting their parental rights because the adoptive parents are now considered their legal guardians.

translations.source: Babbar manufar kimiyya ita ce gano yadda duniya ke wanzuwa ta hanyar kimiyya. Alal hakika wannan hanya ta bincike ita ce ke yin jagora ga mafi yawan bincike na kimiyya.
translations.reference: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: The primary goal of chemistry is to understand how the world works through the application of scientific principles. Indeed, this field of study is at the forefront of many scientific investigations.

translations.source: Ba shi kaɗai bane dai, yin gwaji, kuma gwaji wata hanya ce ta jarrabawa da ake amfani da ita domin kawar da ɗaya ko fiye daga cikin harsashe da za a samu. yin tambayoyi, da fadin ra’ayi su ma suna yin jagora ga binciken kimiyya.
translations.reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: It is not just about experimentation, but also about careful observation and analysis. Experimentation is a method used to test a hypothesis and determine whether it is true or false. Asking questions and expressing opinions are also important parts of the scientific process.

translations.source: Masu rajin ɗabi’ar yanayi da masana falsafa sun maida hankali kan tsofaffin rubuce-rubuce, musamman, akan Baibul da a ka rubuta da yaren Latin.
translations.reference: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.hypothesis: Environmental activists and scholars have focused on key passages, particularly in the Bible, that are written in Latin.

translations.source: Cikin wadanda aka amince da su akwai ra’ayin/fahimtar Aristotle kan dukkan batutuwan kimiyya, ciki har da ilimin halayyar dan adam.
translations.reference: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.hypothesis: Among those who have accepted Aristotle's ideas, including his views on all aspects of science, such as the study of human nature.

translations.source: Kamar yadda ilimin Girka ya ragu, ita yamma ta sami kanta daga yankewar tushen falsafa da tushen kimiyya.
translations.reference: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.hypothesis: As classical studies declined, the West found its identity in the realms of philosophy and science.

translations.source: An lura cewa yawancin tsarukan yadda jiki ke aiki da kuma halayya sun dogara ne da samuwar zangogi yadda abubuwa ke juyawa wadanda agogunan jiki ke samarwa.
translations.reference: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.hypothesis: I have observed that many of the body's functions and behaviors are dependent on the availability of nutrients, particularly those derived from the food we consume.

translations.source: Periodic rithyms, wayenda ba kawai martani bane zuwa ga periodic cues din waje ba, anyi rubutasu akan yawanci halittu masu rai, irin su bakteriya, fungi, bishiyu da dabbobi.
translations.reference: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.hypothesis: Periodic rhythms, which are not only responses to external periodic cues but also influence the behavior of living organisms, such as bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.

translations.source: Halittun jikin mutum sune suke ci gaba da wanzuwa a yayin da mutum ke gudu ko da ba tare da wasu abubuwa daga waje/gefe.
translations.reference: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.hypothesis: The human body continues to function normally even when a person is running or moving without any external objects or assistance.

translations.source: Gwajin Hershey and Chase na daya daga cikin shawarwari na gaba-gaba akan DNA ta kasance genetic material.
translations.reference: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.hypothesis: The Hershey-Chase experiment was one of the first experiments to demonstrate that DNA is the genetic material.

translations.source: Hershey da Chase sun yi amfani da phages, ko ƙwayoyin cututtuka, wajen shigar da sinadarin DNA nasu a cikin wata ƙwayar cuta.
translations.reference: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey and Chase used bacteriophages, or viruses, to introduce their DNA into bacteria.

translations.source: Sunyi gwaje-gwaje guda biyu wanda ke nuna alamar ko DNA a cikin fage tare da phosphorus na rediyoaktif ko furotin na phage tare da sulfur na rediyo.
translations.reference: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.hypothesis: Two tests were conducted, one to detect the presence of DNA in the sample using radioactive phosphorus, and the other to detect the presence of phage DNA using radioactive sulfur.

translations.source: Maye gurbi zai iya samun bambancin nau'ikan sakamako iri daban-daban dangane da nau'in maye gurbi, mahimmancin yanki na kayan gado ya shafa kuma ko kwayoyin halita da abin ya shafa sune kwayoyin halita.
translations.reference: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.hypothesis: The type of soil can vary depending on the type of soil, the importance of the soil, and whether the soil is sandy or clay-based.

translations.source: Rikiɗa a ƙwayoyin halitta na layin ƙwayar cuta ne kaɗai za a iya gadar wa yara, yayin da rikiɗa a wani wuri kan iya haddasa mutuwar ƙwayar halitta ko cutar sankara.
translations.reference: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.hypothesis: Certain types of bacteria can be harmful to humans, while other types can be beneficial. Some bacteria can cause diseases, while others can help to digest food or produce vitamins.

translations.source: Yawon shakatawa na yanayi yana jan hankalin mutane masu sha'awar ziyartar yankuna na asali don jin daɗin shimfidar wuri, gami da tsirrai da dabbobin daji.
translations.reference: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Eco-tourism attracts people who are interested in visiting natural areas to experience wildlife and enjoy the scenery.

translations.source: Misalin ire-iren ayyukan sun hada farauta, kama kifi, yin hoto, kallon tsuntsaye da kuma ziyartar wurin hutawa da kuma koyan ilimi game da labarin muhallin.
translations.reference: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.hypothesis: The activities included a variety of things, such as field trips, nature walks, photography, observing wildlife, and visiting a place of worship, as well as learning about environmental issues.

translations.source: Alal misali, shi ne ziyara da daukar hoto da kuma koyon abubuwan a Borneo.
translations.reference: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: For example, this could involve a visit to Borneo, taking photos, and learning about the local culture and environment.

translations.source: A kowace safiya, mutane na barin ƙananan garuruwan karkara a motoci don zuwa wuraren ayyukan su kuma wasu da idan suka bari ne wajen aikin su na wuce su.
translations.reference: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.hypothesis: Every evening, people leave their small villages in cars to go to work, and some also use their cars to travel between jobs.

translations.source: A cikin wannan na’urar sufuri mai sauyawa kowa na da alaka da juna tare da tallafawa, tsarin sufuri ne wanda ya dogara da motocin daidaikun mutane.
translations.reference: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.hypothesis: This type of public transport system involves a network of buses that operate independently, providing transportation for a large number of people.

translations.source: Ilimin kimiyya yanzu ya nuna cewa wannan babban tattalin arzikin carbon ya lalata biosphere daga ɗayan ƙasashe masu tabbatacce waɗanda suke tallafawa cigaban ɗan adam shekaru miliyan biyu da suka gabata.
translations.reference: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.hypothesis: Scientific research now indicates that this significant carbon-based economy has damaged the biosphere, particularly in stable countries that have supported human progress for the past two centuries.

translations.source: Kowa yana shiga cikin jama'a kuma yana amfani da tsarin sufuri. Kusan kowa yana korafi game da tsarin sufuri.
translations.reference: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone is participating in the public transportation system. Most people are using public transport.

translations.source: A kasashen da suka ci gaba ba kasafai ake jin irin wannan korafin ba game da ingancin ruwa ko gadoji da ke faduwa.
translations.reference: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.hypothesis: Countries that are experiencing rapid development are not facing the same fears about water quality or declining infrastructure.

translations.source: Me yasa tsarukan sufuri su ke haifar da irin waɗannan ƙorafi, me ya sa suke faɗuwa a kullum? Shin injiniyoyin sufuri ne kawai ba ƙwararru ba? Ko akwai wani mahimmin abu di ke faruwa ne?
translations.reference: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.hypothesis: What causes these traffic jams, and why do they occur so frequently? Are traffic engineers solely responsible, or are there other significant factors at play?

translations.source: Gudanar Zirga-zirga shine nazari kan zirga-zirgar ɗaiɗaikun direbobi da ababen hawa tsakanin wurare biyu tare da ma’amala da suke yi da juna.
translations.reference: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.hypothesis: A traffic management, we are concerned with the flow of vehicles and pedestrians between two locations, and the measures taken to ensure smooth and safe movement.

translations.source: Abin takaici, bincikawar zirga-zirga ababen hawa abu ne mai wahala saboda ba’a iya yin hasashen hakikanci halin direba dari bisa dari.
translations.reference: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, analyzing traffic patterns is a complex task because it is difficult to accurately determine the speed of vehicles from one point to another.

translations.source: An yi sa'a, direbobi su na tuki a cikin nutsuwa yadda kwararar ababen hawa a titi ke tafiya a natse don haka ana iya nazarin yanayin ta hanyar lissafi.
translations.reference: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.hypothesis: It's wonderful to see the vibrant colors of the flowers in full bloom, as they sway gently in the breeze. This allows us to appreciate the beauty of nature through observation.

translations.source: Domin gabatar da yanayin hanya, an kulla alaƙa tsakanin muhimman al’amura uku: (1) gudana, (2) cinkoso da (3) watsuwa.
translations.reference: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.hypothesis: To illustrate the concept of road design, three key elements are considered: (1) flow, (2) visibility, and (3) safety.

translations.source: Wadannan dangantaka suna taimakawa wajen tsari, zayyana, da kuma gudanar da kayayyakin babbar hanya.
translations.reference: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.hypothesis: These relationships are essential for the efficient transportation, storage, and distribution of goods.

translations.source: Kwari ne dabbobin da suka fara tashi cikin iska. Iya tashin su ya taimaka musu wajen kauce wa abokan gaba cikin sauki kuma su sami abinci da yin barnara sosai.
translations.reference: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.hypothesis: These are birds that can fly. Their ability to fly helps them to avoid predators and to find food and nesting sites easily.

translations.source: Yawancin kwari suna da fa'idar kasancewa suna iya ninke fuka-fukansu su mayar jikin su.
translations.reference: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.hypothesis: Most people find that wearing comfortable shoes helps to prevent foot problems and keep their feet healthy.

translations.source: Wannan kan ba su faffaɗan fage na kananan wurare da za su iya boyewa daga mafarauta.
translations.reference: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.hypothesis: This could refer to small, scattered farms that can be cultivated independently.

translations.source: A yau, kwarin kawai da ba za su iya linke fikafikan su ba sune kudan diragon da mayflies.
translations.reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.hypothesis: Today, the only insects that can fly without flapping their wings are the mayflies.

translations.source: Dubunnan shekarun da suka gabata, wani mutum da ake kira Aristarchus yace Tsarin Rana ya zagaya Rana.
translations.reference: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.hypothesis: In the past, a man named Aristarchus claimed that the sun was larger than the moon.

translations.source: Wasu mutane suna tsammanin bayaninsa daidai ne, amma wasu da dama na ganin ba haka ba ne; cewa rukunin tauraronmu ke kewaya duniya, ciki har da rana (da ma sauran taurari)
translations.reference: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.hypothesis: Some people believe that the Earth is flat, but many others believe that it is round, including the sun and other celestial bodies.

translations.source: Wannan ya dace da hankali, saboda bai yi kaman duniya tana motsi ba, ko tana yi?
translations.reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.hypothesis: This is a thought-provoking statement, as it doesn't suggest that the world is static or in motion.

translations.source: Ƙoramar Amazon ita ce ƙorama ta biyu mafi tsawo kuma mafi girma a Duniya. Tana ɗaukar ruwa fiye da sau 8 a matsayin babbar ƙorama ta biyu.
translations.reference: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is the second-longest river in the world, measuring approximately 6,992 kilometers in length. It discharges more water than any other river on Earth.

translations.source: Amazon kuma shine kogi mafi fadi a Duniya, a wasu lokutan nisan mil shida.
translations.reference: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon is also the longest river in the world, stretching approximately 6,400 miles.

translations.source: Cikakken kashi 20 cikin dari na ruwan da ke zubowa daga koramun duniyar zuwa cikin teku yana zuwa ne daga Amazon.
translations.reference: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.hypothesis: Approximately 20% of the freshwater that flows from rivers into the ocean originates from the Amazon.

translations.source: Babbar Ƙoramar Amazon ta na da nisan 6,387 km (3,980 mil). Tana karbar ruwa daga dubban kananan ƙoramu.
translations.reference: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is approximately 6,387 km (3,980 miles) long. It receives water from thousands of tributaries.

translations.source: Ko da yake ginin dala a cikin dutse ya ci gaba har zuwa ƙarshen tsohuwar Masarautar, dala ta Giza ba a taɓa wuce ta da girmansu da ƙwarewar fasaha na ginin su ba.
translations.reference: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the presence of a large palace complex within the city, the architecture of Giza did not surpass the skill and craftsmanship of the builders of the ancient Egyptian palaces.

translations.source: Sabuwar Daula ta daulolin baya na Misra su na yaba yadda kakanninsu su ka giggina abubuwa na tarihi, wadanda ko a wancan lokacin sun haura shekaru dubu.
translations.reference: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
translations.hypothesis: The new Egyptian government has announced that its archaeological excavations have uncovered ancient artifacts, some of which are estimated to be thousands of years old.

translations.source: Yawan al’ummar Birnin Vatican ya kai kimanin mutane 800. Ita ce kasa mafi kankanta cikin kasashe masu yancin kansu kuma mafi karancin yawan jama’a.
translations.reference: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
translations.hypothesis: The population of the Vatican City State is approximately 800 people. It is the smallest country in the world and has the smallest population.

translations.source: Fadar Vatican tana amfani da harshen Italiya a dokoki da kuma sadarwar hukuma.
translations.reference: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
translations.hypothesis: The Vatican uses the Italian language in its legal documents and official communications.

translations.source: Yaren Italiyanci kuma yare ne na yau da kullun da yawancin waɗanda ke aiki a cikin jihar ke amfani dashi yayin da ake amfani da Latin a cikin bukukuwan addini.
translations.reference: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
translations.hypothesis: English is a widely used language in the state, and it is often used by people in various professions, particularly in religious contexts where Latin is also employed.

translations.source: Dukkan al’ummar Fadar Vatican ‘yan Dariƙar Katolika ne.
translations.reference: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
translations.hypothesis: All members of the Vatican City are Roman Catholics.

translations.source: Mutane sun san abubuwan da keɓaɓɓun sinadarai kamar su zinariya, azir, da jan ƙarfe daga tsufa, yadda waɗannan za su iya gano su duka a yanayin halitta kuma sun fi sauƙi ga nawa tare da kayan aikin farko.
translations.reference: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
translations.hypothesis: People are aware of the valuable minerals found in rocks, such as gold, silver, and iron, and they understand that these can be found in various geological formations. They also know that these minerals can be relatively easy to identify and extract using basic tools.

translations.source: Aristotle, masanin falsafa ne, yayi tunanin cewa komai ya kunshi cakuda daya ko fiye daga abubuwa hudu. Sun kasance ƙasa, ruwa, iska, da wuta.
translations.reference: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle, the philosopher, believed that everything was composed of one or more of the four elements: earth, water, air, and fire.

translations.source: Wannan ya fi kama da yanayi hudu na abu (a tsari iri daya): daskara, ruwa, iska, da damshi, ko da yake ya kuma yi hasashe da cewa su kan canza zuwa sabbin abubuwa domin zama abin da muke gani.
translations.reference: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
translations.hypothesis: This is similar to the four elements of nature (earth, water, air, and fire), although it also includes the concept that these elements can transform into new things to create what we see.

translations.source: Karafan gami ne na ƙarafa biyu ko fiye da haka. Kar a manta cewa akwai abubuwa da yawa a kan jadawali na lokaci-lokaci.
translations.reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
translations.hypothesis: A timetable, there are usually several rows and columns. Please note that there are many different types of tables.

translations.source: Ana alaƙanta sinadarai kamar calcium da kanwa a zaman ƙarafa. Tabbas, akwai kuma ƙarafa kamar azurfa da zinare.
translations.reference: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.hypothesis: Minerals like calcium and iron are found in foods. Of course, there are also foods that contain other minerals, such as copper and gold.

translations.source: Haka nan za ka iya gamin da ya haɗa da yanki kaɗan na abubuwan da ba ƙarfe ba kamar gawayi.
translations.reference: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
translations.hypothesis: This refers to a type of metal alloy that contains a small amount of non-metallic elements, such as oxygen.

translations.source: Duk wani abu cikin sammai da kassai an yi shi da dunkulen kwayar halittar mara rai. Dukunlen kwayar halitta mara rai ya kunshi kanana kwayoyin zarra.
translations.reference: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
translations.hypothesis: Everything in the sky and on the ground is made of a single type of material: non-metallic minerals. These non-metallic minerals are composed of various elements.

translations.source: Ƙwayoyin zarra ƙanana ne matuƙa inda tiriliyoyinsu kan iya shigewa cikin ɗigon ayar da ke karshen wannan jimla.
translations.reference: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
translations.hypothesis: These small wires are typically located within the insulation of this cable.

translations.source: Hakika, alkalamin babban amini ne ga mutane da dama lokacin da ya fito.
translations.reference: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
translations.hypothesis: Indeed, the word "faith" is a powerful concept for many people when it comes to religion.

translations.source: Abin bakin ciki, yayin da sababbin hanyoyin rubutu suka fito, sai aka mayar da fensir zuwa matsayi da amfani na ƙasa.
translations.reference: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
translations.hypothesis: As new methods of writing emerged, the use of pens gradually declined.

translations.source: Yanzu mutane suna rubuta saƙonni a kan fuskokin kwamfuta, ba tare da sun taɓa kusantar shafana ba.
translations.reference: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, people are writing messages on computer screens without actually touching the keyboard.

translations.source: Mutum zai iya yin mamakin abin da keyboard zai zama idan wani sabon abu ya ɓullo.
translations.reference: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
translations.hypothesis: A person might be surprised by what the keyboard looks like when something new is added.

translations.source: Bam mai tarwatsewa yana aiki ne akan ƙa’idar cewa yana zukar kuzari domin ya dunkule yayan kwayar zarra na protons da neutrons a tsakiyar kwayar zarrar.
translations.reference: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
translations.hypothesis: The experiment is designed to test the hypothesis that a beam of particles is being used to bombard a target in order to induce the emission of protons and neutrons from the nucleus of the target atom.

translations.source: Kamar gangara babban keke zuwa tudu. Tsage tsakiya kuma sannan ya saki wasu daga cikin wannan kuzari.
translations.reference: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
translations.hypothesis: It was like riding a bicycle to the top of the mountain. He struggled, but eventually managed to get everyone up.

translations.source: Wasu kwayar zarra suna da nuclei mai canzawa wanda ya nuna cewa suna iya rabewa da ‘yar ƙarfafawa ko babu .
translations.reference: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
translations.hypothesis: Some types of atoms have a nucleus that can change, indicating that they can either lose or gain neutrons.

translations.source: Farfajiyan wata yana da duwatsu da kura. Ana kiran shimfidar wajen wata crust.
translations.reference: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
translations.hypothesis: The week was filled with both sunshine and rain. The term "week crust" refers to the period of time between rain showers.

translations.source: Kaurin shimfiɗar saman ƙasa ya kai 70 km a gefen kusa da kaurin 100 km a gefen nesa.
translations.reference: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
translations.hypothesis: The diameter of the crater is 70 km, while the surrounding area has a diameter of 100 km.

translations.source: Yana da sirinta a ƙarƙashin maria kuma ya fi kauri a ƙarƙashin tsaunuka.
translations.reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
translations.hypothesis: It grows under the laurel tree and is thicker under rocks.

translations.source: Za a iya samun ƙarin maria a gefen kusa saboda bangon siriri ne. Abu ne mai sauƙi narkakken dutse ya tashi zuwa saman.
translations.reference: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
translations.hypothesis: More marigolds can be found nearby due to the sunny location. It is easy for the flowers to grow and reach towards the sun.

translations.source: Tsarin tallan ya dogara wajen gano abinda ya fi ba mutane sha’awa ko su ka fi so.
translations.reference: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
translations.hypothesis: The advertising strategy relies on identifying what people find appealing or desirable.

translations.source: Waɗannan hasashe suna nuna cewa mutane suna da wasu buƙatu da/ko sha'awa waɗanda akai maida su ciki yayin da suke manyanta zuwa balaga.
translations.reference: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
translations.hypothesis: These findings suggest that people have certain needs or desires that they seek to fulfill while in a public setting.

translations.source: Wadannan ra'ayoyin suna kallon menene game da wasu mutane da ke sa su abubuwan da suke yi da kuma wanne abubuwan ne a muhallin su zai sanya su yi ko kuma kin yin nau’in wasu abu.
translations.reference: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
translations.hypothesis: These questions are asking about the actions of certain people and what environment might cause them to act in a particular way, or what kind of situation might lead them to do something.

translations.source: A matakan bayanan tsarin abubuwa, guda biyu mafi shahara su ne Hierachy of Needs na Maslow Two factor theory na Hertzberg.
translations.reference: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
translations.hypothesis: Two of the most popular models of organizational structure are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs and Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory.

translations.source: A takaice, halaye guda biyu na iya bayyana yayin da manajoji zasu fara jagorantar tsoffin abokan aikinsu. daga cikin ƙarshen bakan yana ƙoƙarin kasancewa “ɗayan mutane” (ko gals).
translations.reference: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
translations.hypothesis: In a typical scenario, two distinct roles emerge when managers begin to lead larger teams. One role is that of the "go-to person" (or go-to gal), who is seen as a reliable and knowledgeable resource.

translations.source: Irin wannan manajan yana da wahalar yanke shawara mara kyau, aiwatar da ladabtarwa, kimanta aikin aiki, sanya nauyi, da ɗaukar mutane da alhaki.
translations.reference: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.hypothesis: This type of manager struggles with making sound decisions, implementing positive feedback, evaluating employee performance, delegating tasks effectively, and motivating staff.

translations.source: A daya ƙarshen ɓarin, mutum zai zama koma wanda ba za'a iya gane shi ba wanda yake ko ta ke jin dole ne ya ko ta canza duk abinda kungiyar ta ke yi kuma su maida shi nasu.
translations.reference: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of the discussion, the person will become completely detached and unable to understand the group's perspective or needs. They will likely refuse to compromise or change their own views, even if it means the group's goals are not achieved.

translations.source: Bayan haka, a ƙarshe jagoran shi yake da alhakin nasara da rashin nasarar kungiyar.
translations.reference: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.hypothesis: Ultimately, the leader was responsible for both the team's success and its failures.

translations.source: Halayyar yawancin lokuta na janyo saɓani tsakanin shugabanni da sauran ‘yan kungiyar.
translations.reference: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.hypothesis: Disagreements often arise between leaders and other members of the group.

translations.source: Tawagogin da bana ainihi ba ana ganinsu daidai da yadda tawagogi na gaske suke, amma dai akwai wasu ‘yan banbance-banbancen da ba za a rasa ba.
translations.reference: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
