translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: Government's policy on issuing identification cards that do not specify gender (X) or updated forms to allow for gender-neutral names.

translations.source: Kasancewar yardar gwamnatocin kasashen waje don girmama waɗannan takardu yana da saurin canzawa.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The practice of foreign governments issuing commemorative stamps is constantly evolving.

translations.source: Bincike a wuraren bincike na jami’an tsaro su ma sun zama da karin shishigi bayan zamanin Satumba 11, 2001.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: Investigations at security agency facilities have also been hampered by the events of September 11, 2001.

translations.source: kada mutanen da suka sauya jinsinsu su yi tsammanin za su iya wuce wa ta gaban na’urorin haska hoton jiki ba tare da fallasar sirri da mutuncinsu ba.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Don't assume that people who change their appearance will be able to avoid being recognized by their physical features, without using disguises or concealing their identities.

translations.source: Igiyar ruwa mai yagawa su ne ruwa ne mai dawowa daga raƙuman ruwa da ke fasa rairayin bakin teku.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: The river water is water that flows from rivers and streams.

translations.source: Saboda yanayin karkashin ruwa da ke sa gudana da mai da hankali a wurare masu zurfi, sannan igiyar ruwa mafi zurfi na iya haduwa a wurin.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the underwater currents and sediment accumulation in areas with deep water, as well as the potential for water to pool, there is a risk of stagnation.

translations.source: Yawancin mace-mace suna faruwa ne sakamakon gajiya da ke ƙoƙari ya koma baya kan na yanzu, wanda ƙila ba zai yiwu ba.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: Divorce is often the result of financial difficulties, as one partner may be unable to provide for the family.

translations.source: Da zarar ka fita daga ruwan, sake komawa ruwan ba zai zo da wata sarkakiya ba.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: Once you have left the water, it will not return to you in the same way.

translations.source: Yi ƙoƙarin auna wani wuri inda ba za a sake samun ka ba ko kuma, ya danganta da ƙwarewarka da kuma cewa ko an gan ka, watakila za ka so jiran ceto.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Try to estimate a location where you won't be found, or, depending on your skills and circumstances, whether you're likely to be seen.

translations.source: Kaɗuwar sake-shiga za ta yi saurin zuwa kafin kaɗuwar al’adu (akwai karancin lokaci na hutun amarci), ya dade, kuma izai ya zama da tsanani sosai.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: The deadline for registration is approaching quickly (with little time left for the holiday), so it's important to act now and avoid any last-minute stress.

translations.source: Matafiya waɗanda ke da sauƙin sauƙaƙawa zuwa sabon al'adun a wasu lokuta suna da matukar wahalar gyara al'adunsu na asali.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Individuals who easily adapt to new cultures sometimes find it difficult to maintain their original traditions.

translations.source: Lokacin dawowa gida bayan zama a ƙasashen waje, kun saba da sabon al'adun kuma kun rasa wasu al'adunku daga al'adunku na gida.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: When you return home after living abroad, you are exposed to new customs and traditions, and you may lose some of the traditions you once held dear.

translations.source: Kasancewa a kasar waje a karo na farko, na sa matafiya yin hakuri da nuna fahimta, saboda sanin cewa matafiya na bukatar hakan domin su saba da wajen.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: Being in a foreign country for the first time, the host family made an effort to be welcoming and understanding, knowing that the guests needed their support to navigate the new environment.

translations.source: Ba lallai Mutane su fahimci cewa yin haƙuri da nuna fahimta wajibi ne ga matafiya da ke kokarin komawa gida.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: It is important for passengers to be aware that showing respect and understanding to drivers is essential for a smooth journey.

translations.source: Sautin dala da wasan haske na daya daga cikin abubuwa masu dadi a fanni kananan yara.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: Playing with money and pretend play is a common and enjoyable activity for young children.

translations.source: Za ka iya ganin dalar a cikin duhu kuma za ka iya ganin su a tsanake kafin shirin ya fara.
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You may see the figures in black and white, or in color, before the program begins.

translations.source: Yawanci kodayaushe ka kan ji sautin ‘yan yawon shakatawa da masu talla. Labarin sauti da hasken to kawai kamar littafin labari ne.
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: I vividly remember the sounds of the bustling marketplace. The noise and activity were like a story unfolding before my eyes.

translations.source: An yi amfani da sassaken zaki na Egypt a matsayin jigo wajen bada dogon labari.
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient Egyptian papyrus was used as a writing material for creating long stories.

translations.source: Ana nuna wuraren akan dalar kuma an haskaka dalolin mabambanta.
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The locations are marked on the map, and the relevant details are provided.

translations.source: Tsibirin Kudancin Shetland, wanda aka gano a cikin 1819, kasashe da yawa suna da'awar su kuma suna da mafi yawan tushe, tare da goma sha shida suna aiki a 2020.
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: The Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several countries, with six of them having active presence there as of 2020.

translations.source: Tsibirin na kwanciye 120 km arewa da sashin kasa mai shiga teku. Mafi girma shine King George Island mai dauke da mazauna na Villa Estrellas.
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The archipelago is located approximately 120 km north of the mainland and consists of a main island, King George Island, which is home to the Villa Estrellas settlement.

translations.source: Sauran sun hada da Livingston Island, da Yaudarar Inda ambaliyar caldera na har dutsen mai fitad da wuta yana ba da tashar jiragen ruwa na halitta.
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: The archipelago includes Livingston Island, which features a caldera with a volcanic crater that provides a harbor for ships.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land shine yanki na kudu da masarautar, da Tekun Bellingshausen ya daure.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: Ellsworth Land is a region in the south of the Antarctic continent, located near the Bellingshausen Sea.

translations.source: Tsaunukan da ke nan wurin a Tsibirin sun haɗe da yankin mai tudu, sannan suka sake bulla a gaba inda suka haifar da jerin carbin Tsaunukan Elsworth na tsawon kilomita 360, wanda dunkulen Ƙanƙarar Minnesota ya ratsa ta tsakiyarsu.
translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: The sand dunes in the area are extensive, and they have shifted over time, creating a series of sand ridges known as the Ellsworth Sand Dunes, which stretch for 360 miles and are traversed by the Minnesota River.

translations.source: Yankin arewacin ko Sentinel Range yana da tsaunukan tsaunuka mafi girma na Antarctica, Vinson Massif, wanda yake hawa sama a tsaunin 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: The Transantarctic Mountains, also known as the Sentinel Range, are the longest mountain range in Antarctica, featuring the Vinson Massif, which is the highest peak in the range, reaching an elevation of 4,892 meters on Mount Vinson.

translations.source: A wurare masu nisa, idan babu sabis na wayar salula, wayar tauraron dan adam na iya zama zaɓin ku kaɗai.
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In areas with limited or no mobile phone service, a landline phone may be the only option for communication.

translations.source: Wayar tauraron dan adam a gaba daya ba za ta maye gurbin wayar hannu ba, domin sai kun kasance a waje tare da yin saiti da tauraron dan adam don yin kiran da wayar.
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: While a wearable device can be convenient, it cannot completely replace a traditional phone. You still need to be in a place where you can set it up and use it to make calls.

translations.source: Ana amfani sosai da aikin a harkokin sufurin ruwa, wanda ya hada da jiragen shakatawa da masu bincike da ke bukatar sadarwa a lungu ko bukatar muryoyi.
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: The use of radio communication in water management is widespread, encompassing both recreational and research vessels that require communication for navigation or data collection.

translations.source: Yakamata kamfanin wayar tarho na yankin ku ya kasance zai iya bada ƙarin bayani game da yin haɗi da wannan sabis ɗin.
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: I recommend that you contact your local telecommunications company to inquire about further information regarding subscribing to this service.

translations.source: Wani zaɓi da ya ke kara samun karbuwa ga waɗanda ke shirin ratar-shekara shine yin tafiya don sani.
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: One option that many people are considering for annual vacations is to travel and explore new places.

translations.source: Wannan ya shahara musamman ga masu tsallake-tsallake a makaranta, suna basu damar ɗaukar shekara guda kafin jami'a, ba tare da lalata karatunsu ba.
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This program is particularly popular with high school students who want to get a head start on their college education without disrupting their high school studies.

translations.source: A lokuta da dama shiga/fara kwas na ratan shekara guda a ketare zai iya inganta damammakinka na kara nosawa gaba a karatu idan ka dawo kasar haihuwarka.
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: Spending time at home during the holidays can actually improve your chances of succeeding in your studies when you return to school.

translations.source: Yawanci za a sami kuɗin karatun shiga don shiga cikin waɗannan shirye-shiryen ilimin.
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: The cost of tuition for these programs will be covered.

translations.source: Finland babban wurin zuwan kwalekwale ne. “Ƙasa mai tafkuna dubu” tana kuma da dubban tsibirai, a cikin tafkuna da kuma cikin rukunin tsibirai.
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.hypothesis: Finland is a popular destination for nature lovers. The country boasts over 188,000 lakes, as well as numerous islands, both on the lakes and in the surrounding sea.

translations.source: A yankunan masu tsibirai barjak da tafkuna ba lallaia bukaci kanana jiragen ruwaba.
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: The areas with dense vegetation and rivers require careful planning and execution when constructing roads.

translations.source: Kodayake tarin tsibirai na bakin teku da manyan tabkuna suna da girman isa ga kowane jirgin ruwa, ƙananan jiragen ruwa ko ma kayak suna ba da kwarewa daban.
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: Although large boats and sizable vessels are suitable for most waterways, small boats or even canoes offer a different kind of experience.

translations.source: Jirgin ruwa jirgi ne na kasar Finland, tare da kwale-kwale ga kowane mutum bakwai ko takwas.
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: The ferry is a Finnish ferry, with seating for approximately seven or eight passengers per trip.

translations.source: Wannan ya dace da Norway, Sweden da New Zealand, amma in ba haka ba ya zama na musamman (misali a cikin Netherlands adadi ɗaya ne zuwa arba'in).
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: This applies to Norway, Sweden, and New Zealand, but in other countries, it may vary (for example, in the Netherlands, the average is one to forty).

translations.source: Yawancin sanannun Baltic Cruises sun ƙunshi karin tsawan zama a St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Many popular Baltic cruises include extended stays in St. Petersburg, Russia.

translations.source: Wannan na nuna cewa kana iya ziyartar birni mai tarihi na kwanaki da dama yayin da ake dawowa ko yin bacci a cikin jirgin ruwan da dare.
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This indicates that you can visit a historic city for several days, whether you are traveling for leisure or taking a nocturnal flight.

translations.source: Idan ka hau ruwa ta amfani da yawon bude ido a jirgin ruwa ba za ka buƙaci biza ta daban ba (kamar daga 2009).
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If you are traveling by boat, you do not need a separate visa (such as one from 2009).

translations.source: Wasu jiragen ruwa su kan sanya Berlin, Jamus a cikin littafin bayanin. Kamar yadda ka ke gani daga taswirar da ke sama babu inda Berlin ta yi kusa da teku kuma ba a haɗa ziyarar birnin ba a farashin jirgi.
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the flights listed include Berlin, Germany. As you can see from the image above, Berlin is not located near the coast, and there is no mention of a flight to the city in the price list.

translations.source: Tafiya ta hanyar jirgin sama kan iya zama abu mai firgitarwa ga mutane a duk rukunin shekaru da asali, musamman idan ba su taɓa hawa jirgi ba ko kuma sun taɓa shiga al’amari mai firgitarwa.
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: Air travel can be an exciting experience for people of all ages, especially if they have never flown before or if they are looking for a unique and memorable adventure.

translations.source: Ba abun jin kunya bane: bata sha bambam da tsoro da kuma rashin kaunar abubuwan da yawancin mutane ke dashi.
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: It is not about seeking validation: it is about finding strength and independence, rather than relying on the approval of others.

translations.source: Ga wasu, fahimtar yadda jirgi yake aiki da kuma ko mene ne ke faruwa yayin da jirgin yake tafiya watakila ya taimaka wajen shawo kan fargabar da tushenta ba a ma san shi ba ko kuma ma ba a iya shawo kansa.
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For some, understanding how a train works and the potential dangers involved can help them overcome their fear of riding them, whether it's the fear of heights, the fear of enclosed spaces, or simply the anxiety of being in a moving vehicle.

translations.source: A na biyan kamfanonin aika saƙonni sosai don isar da abubuwa da sauri. Akai-akai, lokaci yana da matukar mahimmanci game da takardun kasuwanci, abin sayarwa ko kayan gyara don gyara na gaggawa.
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: News agencies rely heavily on efficient communication channels to deliver information quickly. In many cases, speed is of the essence when it comes to business transactions, purchases, or repairs, as delays can have significant consequences.

translations.source: A wasu hanyoyin, manyan kanfanonin na da jiragen samansu, amma a wasu hanyoyi daban da ƙananan kanfanoni akwai matsala.
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: In some cases, large transportation companies have their own fleets of vehicles, but in other cases, smaller companies face challenges.

translations.source: Idan sun aika da kaya ta hanyar jigilar jirgin sama, akan wasu hanyoyi ya zama ya dauki kwanaki kafin a ya tsallake saukewa na ‘yan kwastam.
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: When goods are transported by air, it can take several days for customs officials to clear them for import.

translations.source: Hanya kaɗai mafi saurin wucewarsu shine ta hanyar tura su a matsayin jakunkunan da aka duba. Tsarin dokokin kamfunan zirga-zirgar jiragen sama ba ya bada damar tura jaka ba tare da mai ita zai yi tafiya ba, to anan ne inda za ka shigo.
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: One of the fastest ways to get there is by taking a taxi. The airport's taxi stand is located right outside the terminal, so you can easily find a taxi there.

translations.source: Sananniyar hanya ta tashi a ajin farko ko ajin kasuwanci na jirgin sama shine ka fito da damin kudi domin gata (ko, mafi kyau tukuna, ka sanya kamfaninka su yi maka).
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: A the first or business class of an airplane, you have the opportunity to earn money by using the space (or, better yet, by having your company use it).

translations.source: Sai dai hakan ba ya samuwa cikin sauƙi: a matsayin ƙa’idar ana tsammanin ka biya ribi hudu na ajin marasa ƙarfi kuma ribi goma sha daya na ajin masu wadataa
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: That's not always easy: as a rule, you're expected to pay four times the tax on low-income earners and ten times the tax on high-income earners.

translations.source: A gabaɗaya, babu ma'ana a cikin koda neman ragi don kasuwanci ko kujerun ajin farko a kan jiragen sama kai tsaye daga A zuwa B.
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: In general, there is no need for a specific code to indicate the request for direct flights from A to B for commercial or political purposes.

translations.source: Kamfanonin jiragen sama sun sani sarai cewa akwai wasu rukuni na rukuni na wasiƙa waɗanda suke shirye su biya dala mafi girma don alfarmar zuwa wani wuri cikin sauri da jin daɗi, kuma su biya hakan.
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Airlines have found that there is a segment of passengers who are willing to pay a premium for faster and more comfortable travel, and they are catering to this demand.

translations.source: Babban birnin Moldova shi ne Chişinău. yaren cikin gida shi ne Romaniyanci, amma ana amfani da harshen Rasha sosai.
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is also widely spoken.

translations.source: Maldova jamhuriya ce mai kabilu da dama da ta yi fama da rikicin kabilanci.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: The Republic of Moldova is a small country with a diverse population and a history of ethnic tensions.

translations.source: A shekarar 1994, wannan rikici ya haifar da kirkirar da kanta mai ikirarin Jamhuriyyar Transnistria a gabashin Moldova, wacce ke da gwamnatinta da kudin ta amma ba wata kungiyar mambobin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince da shi ba.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-declared Republic of Transnistria in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency, but is not recognized by any member of the United Nations.

translations.source: An maido da harkar cinikayya tsakanin bangarori biyu na Maldova duk da rushewar tattaunawar siyasa.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: There are ongoing trade negotiations between the two Moldovan factions, despite the political impasse.

translations.source: Babban addini a Moldova shine Kiristocin aqidah.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The dominant religion in Moldova is Christianity.

translations.source: Izmir shi ne birni na uku mafi girma a Turkiyya da yawan jama’a kimanin miliyan 3.7, kuma tashar jiragen ruwa ta biyu mafi girma bayan ta Istanbul, kuma babbar cibiyar sufuri.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir is the third largest city in Turkey, with a population of over 3.7 million, and it is also the second largest port after Istanbul, as well as a major transportation hub.

translations.source: A da yana a matsayin tsohon birnin Smyrna, yanzu cibiyar hada-hadar kasuwanci ce ta zamani, da ta bnƙasa, da ta ke zagayen wani ƙaton mashigin ruwa sannan kuma yana zagaye da duwatsu.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: As the former city of Smyrna, it is now a modern commercial center, with its bustling markets, shops, and waterfront. It also features a large harbor and a number of islands.

translations.source: Manya-manyan tituna, gidajen gilashi da manyan kantunan siyayya an kawata su da jajayen rufi na gargajiya, kasuwa ta karni na 18, da wani tsohon masallaci da coci, koda yake dai garin ya fi kama da irin na turai da ke gabar bahar rum fiye da ace garin gargajiya ne a kasar Turkiya.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The main streets, shops, and large public buildings were all built with traditional materials, reflecting the 18th-century trade and a former mosque and bathhouse. However, the town was more reminiscent of a European settlement along the Black Sea coast than a traditional Turkish city.

translations.source: Kauyen Haldarsvík yana ba da damar kallon tsibirin Eysturoy da ke kusa kuma yana da wata cocin mai kusurwa takwas wadda ba saba ganin irin ta ba.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The viewpoint at Kauyen Haldarsvík offers a stunning view of the Eysturoy island and has a charming church with eight stained-glass windows, which is quite rare.

translations.source: A cikin farfajiyar majami'ar, akwai zane-zanen marmara mai ban sha'awa na kurciya akan wasu kaburburan.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: In the heart of the university campus, there are striking marble sculptures of various figures scattered throughout the grounds.

translations.source: Shafe rabin sa’a na tattaki a cikin shu’umin ƙauyen ya biya.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: Half an hour later, the man arrived at the village square.

translations.source: Ta gefen arewa mai saukin shiga nan ne Birnin Sintra ya ke wanda ya shahara ga yan kasashen waje bayan da Lord Byron ya bada kayatattun labaran kyawonta.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Located in the Algarve region, the town of Sintra is renowned internationally for its stunning scenery, particularly since it became famous after Lord Byron wrote about its beauty.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 na yin tafiya sosai zuwa Sintra, tare da dakatawa a Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Scotturb Bus 403 makes frequent trips to Sintra, with stops in Cabo and Roca.

translations.source: Hakanan zuwa arewa ziyarci babban Wuri Mai Tsarki na Uwargidanmu Fatima (Shrine), wuri ne na shahararrun bayyanar Marian a duniya.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Additionally, a visit to the sacred site of our beloved Fatima (Shrine) is a must. It is one of the most famous Marian shrines in the world.

translations.source: Da fatan za a tuna cewa da gaske ana ziyartar babban kabari ne, kazalika da shafin da ke da kusan ma'ana ga yawancin ɓangarorin duniya.
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: It is important to note that a major summit is a significant event, bringing together representatives from various countries around the world.

translations.source: Har yanzu akwai maza da mata da yawa da ke raye waɗanda suka rayu lokacinsu a nan, kuma da yawa da yawa waɗanda suke da ƙaunatattunsu waɗanda aka kashe ko suka yi aiki zuwa can, yahudawa da waɗanda ba Yahudawa ba.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: There are still many men and women who are living in the area, as well as many others who have been displaced or have lost their homes, including Jews and non-Jews.

translations.source: Da fatan za a kula da rukunin yanar gizon tare da dukkan mutunci, girmamawa da girmama shi. Kada ku yi ba'a game da fitinar Holocaust ko Nazis.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please treat this website with respect, and refrain from any offensive or disrespectful content, particularly regarding the Holocaust or the Nazis.

translations.source: Kada ku lalata wurin ginin ta hanyar sa alamar ko kuma nuna alamar rubutu a cikin ginin.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: Do not damage the building by placing signs or writing on it.

translations.source: Harsunan Barcelona na yau da kullun sune Catalan da Spanish. Kimanin rabin sun fi son yin magana da Catalan, yawancinsu sun fahimce shi, kuma kusan kowa ya san Sifen.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The main languages spoken in Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. Approximately half of the population prefers to speak Catalan, while the majority understand it. Most people are also familiar with Spanish.

translations.source: Ko da yake, ana nuna galibin alamomin ana nuna su Katalanci sakamakon bisa doka shi ne yaren hukumana farko.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: However, it is important to note that the prevalence of the Hausa language is reflected in the fact that it is the first language of a significant portion of the population.

translations.source: Duk da haka, ana kuma amfani da harshen Spanish sosai a harkar sufuri na jama’a da wasu wurare.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: However, the Spanish language is also widely used in public transportation and in some other areas.

translations.source: Ana yin sanarwar yau da gobe a jirgin ƙarƙashin ƙasa a Catalan kaɗai, amma na’urar da ke aiki da kanta ce ke sanar da hargitsin da babu shiri a harsuna iri-iri da suka haɗa da Sifaniyanci, Turanci, Faransanci, Larabci da harshen Japan.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: Anumumkan היום و غداً عبر הודעה שפורסמה בטלוויזיה בカタלאנית, אך המכשיר עצמו הוא זה שמציג ההודעות, כולל התראות על חוסר שירות בשפות שונות, כמו ספרדית, אנגלית, צרפתית, ערבית וגם יפנית.

translations.source: Mutanen Paris sun yi suna kan son kai, rashin kunya da girman kai.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: The people of Paris are known for their arrogance, lack of empathy, and sense of entitlement.

translations.source: Yayin da yake wannan yawanci ra’ayi ne wanda ba daidai ba, hanya mafi kyau don yin sabo a cikin Paris har yanzu shine kasancewa kan halayyarka mafi kyau, yin aiki kamar wanda yake “bien élevé” (wanda ya sami tarbiyya mai kyau). Zai sanya yin sabo ya kasance mai sauki.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: While this is a common perception, the best way to stand out in Paris is to maintain your impeccable style and behave in a way that reflects a refined upbringing. This will make you stand out in a positive way.

translations.source: Fuskar mutanen Paris ta bazata za ta yi saurin ɓacewa idan ka nuna wasu halayen girmamawa.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: The people of Paris are known for their quick wit and ability to respond with humor to various situations.

translations.source: Tafkunan Plitvice na wajen shakatawa yana da wani surkukin daji, galibi da kamannin bishiyoyin fir da na kudan zuma da kuma hadin wanda ya shafi manyan tsaunuka da duwatsu tare da ciyaye na Rum.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: The Plitvice Lakes National Park is a stunning natural wonder, featuring a series of interconnected lakes, waterfalls, and forests. The lakes are fed by underground rivers and streams, and the surrounding area is home to a variety of wildlife, including bears, deer, and wolves.

translations.source: Tana da sanannun dangogin itatuwa iri daban-daban, sabo da jerin yankunan yanayi da ta ke da su, da bayyana nau’ukan ƙasa daban-daban da kuma tuddai masu mataki daban-daban.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: It boasts a wide range of attractions, including diverse landscapes, a variety of climates, and different types of terrain.

translations.source: Rukunin muhalli na ga dabbobin daji mabambanta da kuma launukan tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: The environmental group focuses on endangered species and unique landscapes.

translations.source: Dabbobin daji da ba su da yawa irin su Malu mai launin ruwan kasa da ke turai, kerkeci, mikiya, mujiya, kyanwar daji da kuma capercaillie a na iya samun su a can, tare da nau’ukan gama garin dabbobi masu yawa.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: Various species of birds, including the Eurasian robin, blackbird, chaffinch, goldfinch, and capercaillie, can be found here, along with a wide variety of other bird species.

translations.source: Yayin ziyartar gidajen sufaye, an buƙaci mata su sa riguna masu rufe gwiwowinsu kuma su rufe ƙafadunsu, kuma.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: During visits to museums, women were required to wear clothing that covered their arms and legs, and.

translations.source: Mafi yawancin gidajen ibada suna samar da mayafai ga matan da ba su zo da shiri ba, amma idan ki ka zo da naki, musamman wanda yake da launuka masu haske, za ki sami murmushi daga mai bauta namiji ko mace a ƙofar shiga.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Many churches offer gifts to women who do not bring a date, but if you come with a date, especially one who is well-dressed, you are likely to receive a smile from the usher or whoever is at the entrance.

translations.source: A bisa wannan madogara, ana buƙatar maza su sanya wanduna da ke rufe gwiwoyi.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: Based on this information, men are advised to wear underwear that covers their groin area.

translations.source: Wannan ma za a iya aro shi daga tarin kayan a mashigar amma ba a wanke tufa bayan kowane mutum guda ya yi amfani da tufar don haka ba za ka/ki ji dadin saka wannan bujen ba. Kala guda zai iyamma dukkanin maza.
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: This type of shirt can be made from a variety of fabrics, but it is not very comfortable to wear because each person has to wash it themselves. One shirt will only last for a few days.

translations.source: Babban abincin, kamar na yankuna masu kama da wannan a cikin Bahar Rum, ya dogara ne akan burodi, kayan lambu da nama (musamman alade), kuma yana amfani da man zaitun ko'ina.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The main ingredient, similar to those found in similar regions in the Black Sea, is anchovies, along with fish and meat (especially lamb), and olive oil is used extensively.

translations.source: Abincin dare mai sauki musamman ma lokacin bazara, shi ne na Pa amb Oli: Burodi ne da man zaitun da tumatir da kuma duk wani kayan hadin da ya samu kamar cukwui da abincin kifi da dai sauransu.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: A special evening meal, especially during the holidays, often includes Pa amb Oli: This consists of bread, olive oil, and various ingredients such as tomatoes, onions, and spices.

translations.source: Dukkan sunaye, wadanda ke da kalmar Sie a ciki, koda yaushe suna farawa ne da babban harafi, koda a tsakiyar jimla ne.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All words that contain the letter "Sie" always begin with a capital letter, even if they are in the middle of a sentence.

translations.source: Wannan mahimmiyar hanya ce wajen banbance kalmomin aikatau da kalmomi na abubuwa da ake iya gani.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This is an important method for distinguishing between words that refer to actions and words that refer to things that can be seen.

translations.source: Hakanan yana iya kawo sauƙin karatu, kodayake rubutu yana da ɗan rikitarwa ta hanyar buƙatar gano ko ana amfani da fi'ili ko sifa a cikin sigar tabbatarwa.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: It can also lead to easier reading, although the text may be somewhat complex due to the need to identify whether a verb or adjective is used in the subjunctive mood.

translations.source: Furuci yana da ɗan sauƙi a cikin Italiyanci tunda yawancin kalmomi ana furta daidai yadda ake rubuta suu
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: The Italian language is relatively straightforward, as most words are pronounced exactly as they are written.

translations.source: Manyan haruffan da ya kamata a lura da su a nan sune c da g, kasancewar furucinsu ya banbamta daga wannan wasalin da ke biye.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The key things to note are the type of fabric, the fit of the garment, and how well it complements the overall look.

translations.source: Hakanan, tabbatar da furta r da rr daban: caro yana nufin ƙaunata, yayin da karas yana nufin karusa.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, it is important to distinguish between "furta" and "rr": "furta" means acquaintance, while "rr" means a type of plant.

translations.source: Farisa tana da nahawu mai sauki da na yau da kullum.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: Farisa is a simple and everyday language.

translations.source: Saboda haka, karanta wannan share fagen nahawun zai taimaka muku koya da yawa game da nahawun Farisanci da fahimtar jumla da kyau.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, reading this article on the topic will help you learn a lot about the nuances of English and develop a better understanding of the language.

translations.source: A bayyane take, idan ka san yaren Romance, zai yi sauki maka ka koyi Portuguese.
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: It's clear that if you already know a Romance language, learning Portuguese will be much easier for you.

translations.source: Duk da haka, mutanen da ba su iya yaren sifaniyanci sosai ba ke ganin yaren Portuguese ya yi kusa da shi yadda ba lallai a karance shi daban ba.
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: However, people who do not speak Spanish often find that Portuguese is quite similar, making it relatively easy for them to learn.

translations.source: Yawanci hasumiyoyin nazarin samaniya na baya sun zama tsohon yayi yanzu, inda suka zama gidajen kayan tarihi, ko kuma wuraren koyon ilimi.
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: Former schools and educational institutions have been transformed into historical landmarks or centers for learning.

translations.source: Kamar yadda gurbacewar haske a lokacin ganiyasa ba kamar irin yadda matsalar take a halin yanzu ba, galibi ya fi yawa a birane da kuma harabobin makarantun jami’a, wanda ya fi saukin samuwa akan wadanda aka gina a birane.
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: Unlike the darkness experienced during wartime, which was often concentrated in urban areas and around universities, the current darkness is more widespread and affects a larger population.

translations.source: Yawancin gilasan hangen nesa na bincike na zamani kayayyaki ne masu girma sosai a yankunan da ke da tsarin yanayi masu kyau.
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Most modern research laboratories are located in areas with favorable climates.

translations.source: Kallon buɗewar furen cherry, wanda aka sani da hanami, ya kasance wani ɓangare na al'adun Japan tun ƙarni na 8.
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: The introduction of the cherry blossom, also known as hanami, was a significant part of Japanese culture dating back to the 8th century.

translations.source: Tunanin ya fito ne daga China inda plum da suka yi girma sun kasance fure ne wanda aka fi so.
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: The plum originated in China, where the large, dark plums were highly prized.

translations.source: A Japan, sarkin ne ya shirya kungiyar siyasa na farko don kan sa kawai da wasu membobin da ke da martaba kewaye da kotun sarakuna..
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: In Japan, a powerful businessman organized the first political party specifically to support himself and a few other wealthy and influential figures.

translations.source: Tsirrai sun fi kyau idan suna muhallinsu na halitta, saboda haka guji zumuɗin tsige ko da samfur “daya ne kawai”.
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: Caterpillars are best when they are in their natural environment, so avoid disturbing them or handling them unnecessarily.

translations.source: Idan kana ziyartar shiryayen lambu, tattara “samfurori” shi ma zai iya jawo wa a fitar da kai, ba tare da tattaunawa ba.
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: If you are visiting a museum, you may find that the exhibits themselves can evoke a strong emotional response, without any need for explanation.

translations.source: Garin Singapore gari ne da akasari ya ke da tsaro ingantacce kuma da saukin ganewa, kuma ka na iya siyen komai daga saukarka a kasar.
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is a city-state known for its high safety standards and ease of getting around. You can find almost anything you need in the city, from everyday essentials to luxury goods.

translations.source: Amma ana sanya ku a cikin “manyan yankuna masu tsaka-tsakin” kawai ƴan digiri kaɗan arewacin kerjin za ku buƙaci ma'amala da zafin rana (koyaushe) da rana mai ƙarfi (lokacin da sama ta bayyana, mafi wuya).
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: However, you will only be placed in "relatively stable" areas, requiring minimal management of both extreme cold (constantly) and intense heat (during periods of strong sunlight, which is the most challenging).

translations.source: Akwai kuma motocin bas kaɗan masu tafiya arewa zuwa Hebron, asalin wurin da aka binne shugabanni da aka ambata a baibul Ibrahim, Isa, Yakub, da matansu.
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: There are also a few vehicles that offer tours north to Hebron, the site where the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, along with their families, are believed to have lived.

translations.source: Ka tabbatar motar da zaka shiga lalle wadda za ta je Hebron ce ba wadanda ke zuwa sabbin unguwanni yahudawa da ke Kiryat Arba ba ne.
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Please ensure that the vehicle you are using to travel to Hebron is not one that is heading towards the new Jewish settlements in Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Jirgin ruwa na cikin gida na iya zama jigo mai kyau don kafa hutu a kusa.
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: An indoor water fountain can be a beautiful addition to any home, creating a relaxing and tranquil atmosphere.

translations.source: A misali ziyartar fadoji a Loire Valley, kwarin Rhine ko hawan jirgin ruwa zuwa wurare masu ban sha’awa a Danube ko tafiya cikin kwalekwale ta Erie Canal.
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, a scenic boat trip through the Loire Valley, a cruise on the Rhine River, or a river journey to interesting places on the Danube, or a canal tour on the Erie Canal.

translations.source: Hakanan suna ayyana hanyoyi don shahararrun tattaki da hanyoyin keke.
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: They also outline routes for popular walking and cycling paths.

translations.source: Kirsimeti wani biki ne mai mahimmanci na Kiristanci, kuma ana bikinta a matsayin ranar haihuwar Yesu.
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is a significant Christian holiday, celebrated as the day of the birth of Jesus.

translations.source: Da yawan an al’adun da ke zgaye da bikin sun sami karɓuwa har daga waɗanda ba su yi imani ba a kasashen kristoci da waɗanda bana kristoci ba a fadin duniya.
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: Many traditional customs and rituals have been adopted, even by those who do not practice religion in Christian countries, and by non-Christians in other parts of the world.

translations.source: Akwai wata al'ada ta kwanan zaune a daren Easter a wani wuri buɗaɗɗe don ganin fitowar rana.
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a tradition of gathering in a public place in the evening of Easter to watch the sunset.

translations.source: Tabbas da akwai bayanai daga koyarwar addinin Kirista kan wannan al’adar, amma dai yana iya kasancewa Shekaru ne gabanin bayyanar Kiristanci.
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: Certainly, there are accounts from Christian teachings about this custom, but it may also predate the spread of Christianity.

translations.source: Churchesarin majami'u na gargajiya sau da yawa suna yin Vigil na Easter a daren Asabar a lokacin karshen mako na Ista, tare da ikilisiyoyin galibi suna shiga cikin murna a tsakar dare don bikin tashin Almasihu.
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Many historical universities are holding Easter vigils on Saturday evening during the final days of Holy Week, with many churches also holding special services in the evening to celebrate the resurrection of Jesus.

translations.source: Duk dabbobin da suka isa tsibirin asalin sun zo nan ne ta hanyar iyo, tashi ko iyo.
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: All the animals that arrived at the watering hole came there by walking, swimming, or being carried.

translations.source: Saboda doguwar nesa daga nahiyoyi masu shayarwa ba su iya yin tafiyar ba wanda ya sa katowar kunkuru matsayin dabba ta farko da ake kiwo a Galapagos.
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to their isolation from other islands, the Galapagos finches developed unique characteristics that made them the first species to be studied in detail.

translations.source: Tun zuwan mutum ga Galapagos, an gabatar da dabbobi masu shayarwa da yawa da suka hada da awaki, dawakai, shanu, beraye, kuliyoyi da karnuka.
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Since the arrival of humans on the Galapagos Islands, a wide variety of introduced species have been brought, including tortoises, iguanas, finches, mockingbirds, sea lions, and sharks.

translations.source: Idan ka ziyarci nahiyar Arctic ko Antarctica a lokacin hunturu zaka tsinkayi daren sanyi, wanda a lokacinsa rana bata fitowa.
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic regions during winter, you will experience the long, dark nights, during which the sun does not appear.

translations.source: Wannan yana ba da kyakkyawar dama don ganin Aurora borealis, tunda sama zata kasance mai duhu sosai ko ƙasa da agogo.
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: This provides a great opportunity to see the Aurora Borealis, as the sky will be very dark or completely black.

translations.source: Tunda yankunan ba su da cinkoson jama’a, kuma babu matsalar gurɓacewar haske, za kuma ka ji daɗin taurarin.
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: Since the areas are sparsely populated and there is no risk of light pollution, you can enjoy the clear night sky.

translations.source: Al’adun aiki na Japanese na da matsayi fiye da abin da kasashen yamma suka saba.
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: The Japanese work culture is significantly different from that of Western countries.

translations.source: Kwat sune kayan sawa na aiki da aka saba dasu kuma abokan aiki suna kiran juna ne da sunan gidan su ko kuma matsayin da mutum yake kai.
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: These are the names used in the workplace, and colleagues often refer to each other by their first names, company names, or job titles.

translations.source: Zaman lafiya a wurin aiki abu ne me muhimmanci, ana bada mahimmanci wurin hadaka tare sama da jinjina yin aiki kai daya.
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: A safe and healthy work environment is essential, as it promotes teamwork and productivity.

translations.source: Dole ne ma’aikata su sami amincewar manyan su akan duk wata shawara da suka zartas, kuma ana tsammanin su yi biyayya ga umarnin manyan su ba tare da tambaya ba.
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Employees are expected to obtain approval from their superiors before implementing any new policy or decision, and it is assumed that they will follow their instructions without question.
